11.3.66.d: प्रसिद्धो ऽभिषवः प्रसिद्धं ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते समानं कर्माग्रयणाद् ग्रहाद्
11.3.66.m: The pressing is established. The cups are drawn in the established manner. The procedure is the same up to the āgrayaṇa cup.

11.3.66.s: āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhītvā pañcaindrān atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti | upayāmagṛhīto 'si nṛṣadaṃ tvā druṣadam ity etābhiḥ pañcabhir
11.3.66.d: आग्रयणं गृहीत्वा पञ्चैन्द्रान् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि नृषदं त्वा द्रुषदम् इत्य् एताभिः पञ्चभिर्
11.3.66.m: Having drawn the āgrayaṇa cup, he draws five atigrāhya cups for Indra with these five [verses]: 'You are taken with a support; you who sit among men, who sit in the wood…'
Then he deposits them together in a cluster on the south-eastern part of the mound.

11.3.67.s: yāvad evātrādhvaryuś ceṣṭati tāvad eṣa pratiprasthātā sata udīcīnadaśena vālena surāṃ punāti punātu te parisrutam̐ somam̐ sūryasya duhitā vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā | iti
11.3.67.d: यावद् एवात्राध्वर्युश् चेष्टति तावद् एष प्रतिप्रस्थाता सत उदीचीनदशेन वालेन सुरां पुनाति पुनातु ते परिस्रुतँ सोमँ सूर्यस्य दुहिता वारेण शश्वता तना । इति
11.3.67.m: While the adhvaryu priest is engaged here, the pratiprasthātṛ priest purifies the surā from the vessel through the hair-strainer with fringes pointing to the north, reciting: 'May the daughter of the sun purify your flowing soma through the perpetual, continuous hair[-strainer]!'
The adhvaryu priest takes up a vāyavya cup, and the pratiprasthātṛ priest takes up an upayāma cup.

11.3.67.s: adhvaryuḥ pūrvo vāyavyena droṇakalaśāt somagrahān gṛhṇāti | ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yoniḥ prajāpataye tvā | iti |
11.3.67.d: अध्वर्युः पूर्वो वायव्येन द्रोणकलशात् सोमग्रहान् गृह्णाति । अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिः प्रजापतये त्वा । इति ।
11.3.67.m: The adhvaryu priest, being the first, draws the soma-cups from the droṇakalaśa trough with the vāyavya cup, reciting: 'Creating wonderful deeds by this course…' and: 'You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Prajāpati.' Having wiped it around, he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for Prajāpati you!'

11.3.67.s: atha pratiprasthātopayāmena satāt surāgrahān gṛhṇāti kuvid aṅga yavamantas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā | iti gṛhṇāti
11.3.67.d: अथ प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामेन सतात् सुराग्रहान् गृह्णाति कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा । इति गृह्णाति
11.3.67.m:
Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest draws the surā-cups from the vessel with the upayāma cup, reciting: 'Where indeed barley-growers…', and draws it with: 'You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati you!'

He deposits it with: 'For Prajāpati you!'; he does not say 'agreeable' nor does he assign a 'womb.'

11.3.67.s: prajāpataye tvā | iti sādayati naiva juṣṭaṃ karoti na yonim |
11.3.67.d: प्रजापतये त्वा । इति सादयति नैव जुष्टं करोति न योनिम् ।

11.3.67.s: tāv evam eva vyatiṣaṅgaṃ grahān gṛhṇītaḥ saptadaśetaraḥ saptadaśetaraḥ
11.3.67.d: ताव् एवम् एव व्यतिषङ्गं ग्रहान् गृह्णीतः सप्तदशेतरः सप्तदशेतरः
11.3.67.m: The two draw the cups in this very way alternately, seventeen for the one and seventeen for the other.

11.3.67.s: puro 'kṣam evādhvaryuḥ somagrahān dviśreṇi vā triśreṇi vodīca āyātayati
11.3.67.d: पुरो ऽक्षम् एवाध्वर्युः सोमग्रहान् द्विश्रेणि वा त्रिश्रेणि वोदीच आयातयति
11.3.67.m: In front of the axle itself, the adhvaryu priest arranges the soma-cups facing north, in two rows or in three rows.

11.3.67.s: paścād akṣaṃ pratiprasthātā surāgraḥn dviśreṇi vā traśreṇi vodīca āyātayati |
11.3.67.d: पश्चाद् अक्षं प्रतिप्रस्थाता सुराग्रःन् द्विश्रेणि वा त्रश्रेणि वोदीच आयातयति ।
11.3.67.m: Behind the axle, the pratiprasthātṛ priest arranges the cups of surā pointing north, in two rows or in three rows.

11.3.67.s: atha ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahan ratham ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine | iti |
11.3.67.d: अथ षोडशिनं गृह्णाति । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन् रथम् इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने । इति ।
11.3.67.m: Then he draws the ṣoḍaśin cup. Having recited, 'Mount the chariot, O slayer of Vṛtra...', [he draws it with,] 'You are taken with a base: I draw you agreeable to Indra of the sixteen.' Having wiped it, he deposits it with, 'This is your base; for Indra of the sixteen [thee].'
Then he draws the ukthya cup. The procedure is the same up to the cup for the Aśvins.

11.3.68.s: āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā ṣaḍraśanā āḍāya yūpam abhyaiti
11.3.68.d: आश्विनं ग्रहं गृहीत्वा षड्रशना आडाय यूपम् अभ्यैति
11.3.68.m: Having drawn the cup for the Aśvins, having taken six ropes, he goes towards the sacrificial post.

11.3.68.s: svarvantaṃ yūpam utsṛjyāthaitān paśūn upākaroty āgneyam aindrāgnam aindraṃ mārutīṃ govaśām̐ saptadaśa prājāpatyān chyāmān ekarūpān sārasvatīm antataḥ
11.3.68.d: स्वर्वन्तं यूपम् उत्सृज्याथैतान् पशून् उपाकरोत्य् आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् ऐन्द्रं मारुतीं गोवशाँ सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान् छ्यामान् एकरूपान् सारस्वतीम् अन्ततः
11.3.68.m: Having left the sacrificial post endowed with a sun-charm, he then brings forward these animal victims: one dedicated to Agni, one to Indra-Agni, one to Indra, a barren cow to the Maruts, seventeen dark, uniform ones to Prajāpati, and finally one to Sarasvatī.

11.3.68.s: atha nirmanthyasyāvṛtā nirmanthyena carati prahatyābhihutyāthaitān nānādevatyān paśūn pṛthag dviguṇābhir abhidhāya pṛthak triguṇāsu niyunakti |
11.3.68.d: अथ निर्मन्थ्यस्यावृता निर्मन्थ्येन चरति प्रहत्याभिहुत्याथैतान् नानादेवत्यान् पशून् पृथग् द्विगुणाभिर् अभिधाय पृथक् त्रिगुणासु नियुनक्ति ।
11.3.68.m: Then he proceeds with the churned [fire] in the manner of the churned [fire]. Having thrown it in and made the offering, having tied these victims dedicated to various deities separately with double-stranded [ropes], he binds them separately to three-stranded [ropes].

11.3.68.s: athaitān samānadevatyān paśūn pṛthag dviguṇābhir abhidhāyaikasyāṃ yūpyayām niyunakty api vā paśau paśuṃ prasajati
11.3.68.d: अथैतान् समानदेवत्यान् पशून् पृथग् द्विगुणाभिर् अभिधायैकस्यां यूप्ययाम् नियुनक्त्य् अपि वा पशौ पशुं प्रसजति
11.3.68.m: Then, having tied these victims dedicated to the same deity separately with double-stranded [ropes], he binds them to a single rope for the post, or else he attaches victim to victim.

11.3.68.s: sārasvatīm antato niyujyāthainān prokṣya nipāyyopokṣyodūhya prokṣaṇīdhānam ||
11.3.68.d: सारस्वतीम् अन्ततो नियुज्याथैनान् प्रोक्ष्य निपाय्योपोक्ष्योदूह्य प्रोक्षणीधानम् ॥
11.3.68.m: Having bound the [victim] for Sarasvatī last, having sprinkled them, made them drink, sprinkled them again, and pushed aside the vessel containing the sprinkling waters,

11.4.68.m: then taking a kindling stick from the kindling wood, he says: 'Recite for Agni being kindled.'
He puts the kindling wood [on the fire]. He leaves over a kindling stick. He fans it with the broom.

11.4.68.s: anūktāsu sāmidhenīṣu sruveṇāghāram āghārayati saṃmṛṣṭe srugbhyām uttaram
11.4.68.d: अनूक्तासु सामिधेनीषु स्रुवेणाघारम् आघारयति संमृष्टे स्रुग्भ्याम् उत्तरम्
11.4.68.m: When the sāmidhenī verses have been recited, he pours the base-libation with the dipping spoon. When [the ladles] have been cleansed, [he pours] the further one with the two ladles.

11.4.68.s: athāsam̐sparśayan srucāv udaṅṅ atyākramya juhvā paśūn samajya sādayitvā srucau pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte
11.4.68.d: अथासँस्पर्शयन् स्रुचाव् उदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य जुह्वा पशून् समज्य सादयित्वा स्रुचौ प्रवरं प्रवृणीते
11.4.68.m: Then, keeping the two ladles from touching, stepping across towards the north, having anointed the animal victims with the juhū ladle and deposited the two ladles, he chooses the ancestral invocation.
He chooses the officiating priests in the established manner.

11.4.68.s: sīdati hotā prasavam ākāṅkṣati prasūtaḥ srucāv ādāyātyākramyāśrāvyāha samidbhyaḥ preṣya | iti
11.4.68.d: सीदति होता प्रसवम् आकाङ्क्षति प्रसूतः स्रुचाव् आदायात्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह समिद्भ्यः प्रेष्य । इति
11.4.68.m: The hotṛ priest sits down. He awaits the impulse. Impelled, taking the two ladles, stepping across, and having made the call, he says: 'Prompt for the kindling sticks.'
When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he pours the offering, saying: 'Prompt, prompt.'

11.4.68.s: catruthāṣṭamayoḥ samānayamāno 'ṣṭame sarvam̐ samānayate pari svāhākṛtībhyaḥ sam̐srāvam̐ śinaṣṭi
11.4.68.d: चत्रुथाष्टमयोः समानयमानो ऽष्टमे सर्वँ समानयते परि स्वाहाकृतीभ्यः सँस्रावँ शिनष्टि
11.4.68.m: Bringing together [the ghee] at the fourth and eighth [fore-offerings], he brings it all together at the eighth. He leaves over the residue for the svāhākāra offerings.

11.4.68.s: daśa prayājān iṣṭvodaṅṅ atyākramya svaruśāsaiḥ paśūn samanakti
11.4.68.d: दश प्रयाजान् इष्ट्वोदङ्ङ् अत्याक्रम्य स्वरुशासैः पशून् समनक्ति
11.4.68.m: Having offered the ten fore-offerings, stepping across towards the north, he anoints the animal victims with the chips from the post and the slaughtering knives.

11.4.69.s: ta ete nānādevatyāḥ paśavo nānāsvaravo nānāśāsās |
11.4.69.d: त एते नानादेवत्याः पशवो नानास्वरवो नानाशासास् ।
11.4.69.m: These animal victims dedicated to various deities have different chips and different slaughtering knives.
Then these animal victims dedicated to the same deity have the same chip and different slaughtering knives.

11.4.69.s: samānaṃ karmā paryagnikaraṇāt | atha paryagnikṛtaiḥ paśubhir udañcaḥ pratipadyante
11.4.69.d: समानं कर्मा पर्यग्निकरणात् । अथ पर्यग्निकृतैः पशुभिर् उदञ्चः प्रतिपद्यन्ते
11.4.69.m: The procedure is the same up to the carrying of fire around [the victims]. Then, with the victims around which fire has been carried, they proceed towards the north.
Among them, the one for Sarasvatī is to the northern side.

11.4.69.s: āgneya upacāratas | āgneyam evādhvaryur vapāśrapaṇībhyām anvārabhate pṛthag itarān parikarmiṇa udañco nayanty anupūrvam avyatiṣajanta
11.4.69.d: आग्नेय उपचारतस् । आग्नेयम् एवाध्वर्युर् वपाश्रपणीभ्याम् अन्वारभते पृथग् इतरान् परिकर्मिण उदञ्चो नयन्त्य् अनुपूर्वम् अव्यतिषजन्त
11.4.69.m: The one for Agni is at the place of ritual action. The adhvaryu priest touches only the [victim] for Agni with the two omentum-cooking forks; the assistants lead the others separately towards the north in order, without intermingling.

11.4.69.s: āgneyāyaivādhvaryuḥ paśave nihanyamānāya barhir upāsyati pṛthag itarebhyas
11.4.69.d: आग्नेयायैवाध्वर्युः पशवे निहन्यमानाय बर्हिर् उपास्यति पृथग् इतरेभ्यस्
11.4.69.m: The adhvaryu priest throws sacrificial grass only for the victim for Agni as it is being killed, [and others do so] separately for the other [victims].

11.4.69.s: tata itarān prāco vodīco vā nighnanti | akṛṇvato māyūn saṃjñapayata | ity uktvaitenaiva yathetam etya pṛṣadājyāvakāśa āsate | iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām asmin yajñe viśvavido ghṛtācīḥ | agniṃ kulāyam abhisaṃvasānās | asmām̐ avantu payasā ghṛtena | iti
11.4.69.d: तत इतरान् प्राचो वोदीचो वा निघ्नन्ति । अकृण्वतो मायून् संज्ञपयत । इत्य् उक्त्वैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य पृषदाज्यावकाश आसते । इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् अस्मिन् यज्ञे विश्वविदो घृताचीः । अग्निं कुलायम् अभिसंवसानास् । अस्माँ अवन्तु पयसा घृतेन । इति
11.4.69.m: Then they kill the others facing east or north. Having said, 'Quiet them without making them bleat,' having returned by the very way they went, they sit down at the space for the speckled butter, reciting: 'May creatures of all forms rest here, butter-bearing [cows] that know all things in this sacrifice; dwelling together towards Agni as a nest, may they protect us with milk and butter.'

11.4.69.s: saṃjñaptān prāhur juhoti saṃjñaptāhutiṃ yat paśavo māyūn akṛṣata | iti |
11.4.69.d: संज्ञप्तान् प्राहुर् जुहोति संज्ञप्ताहुतिं यत् पशवो मायून् अकृषत । इति ।
11.4.69.m: They announce them as quieted. He offers the oblation for the quieted [victims] with: 'If the victims have made bleating...'
Then he approaches, saying: 'O slaughterers, come forward.'

11.4.69.s: pāśebhyaḥ paśūn pramucyamānān anumantrayate | aditiḥ pāśān pramumoktv etān iti
11.4.69.d: पाशेभ्यः पशून् प्रमुच्यमानान् अनुमन्त्रयते । अदितिः पाशान् प्रमुमोक्त्व् एतान् इति
11.4.69.m: As the victims are being untied from the nooses, he recites over them: 'May Aditi untie these nooses.'

11.4.69.s: pṛthag aviśākhābhir upasajyemāṃ diśaṃ nirasyati | arātīyantam adharaṃ kṛṇomi yaṃ dviṣmas tasmin pratimuñcāmi pāśān iti ||
11.4.69.d: पृथग् अविशाखाभिर् उपसज्येमां दिशं निरस्यति । अरातीयन्तम् अधरं कृणोमि यं द्विष्मस् तस्मिन् प्रतिमुञ्चामि पाशान् इति ॥
11.4.69.m: Having joined [them] separately with sheep-forks, he casts them away in this direction, reciting: 'I make low the one who acts with malice; on him whom we hate do I bind the nooses.'

11.5.70.s: atha pratiprasthātā patnīm udānayaty udakamaṇḍalum utthāpya
11.5.70.d: अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीम् उदानयत्य् उदकमण्डलुम् उत्थाप्य
11.5.70.m: Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest leads the wife [of the sacrificer] up, having lifted a jar of water.

11.5.70.s: sānupūrvaṃ paśūnāṃ prāṇān āpyāyayati | anvag adhvaryur vapā utkhidann eti | āgneyasyaivādhvaryur vapayā prathamayā pratipadyate 'nūcīr itarā āharanti |
11.5.70.d: सानुपूर्वं पशूनां प्राणान् आप्याययति । अन्वग् अध्वर्युर् वपा उत्खिदन्न् एति । आग्नेयस्यैवाध्वर्युर् वपया प्रथमया प्रतिपद्यते ऽनूचीर् इतरा आहरन्ति ।
11.5.70.m: She refreshes the breaths of the animal victims in order. The adhvaryu priest follows behind, drawing out the omenta. The adhvaryu priest proceeds with the omentum of the victim for Agni first; they bring the other ones following in succession.

11.5.70.s: āgneyasyaiva vapāyai pratitapyamānāyai barhiṣo 'gram upāsyaty upetarā yacchanti |
11.5.70.d: आग्नेयस्यैव वपायै प्रतितप्यमानायै बर्हिषो ऽग्रम् उपास्यत्य् उपेतरा यच्छन्ति ।
11.5.70.m: He throws the tip of the sacrificial grass onto the omentum of the one for Agni as it is being heated; they hold out the others near it.

11.5.70.s: āgneyasyaiva vapām̐ sruvāhutyābhijuhoty upetarā yacchanti | atha svāhākṛtipraiṣeṇa caritvā sam̐srāveṇa pṛṣadājyam abhighāryāgneyasyaiva vapām abhighārayaty upetarā yacchanti |
11.5.70.d: आग्नेयस्यैव वपाँ स्रुवाहुत्याभिजुहोत्य् उपेतरा यच्छन्ति । अथ स्वाहाकृतिप्रैषेण चरित्वा सँस्रावेण पृषदाज्यम् अभिघार्याग्नेयस्यैव वपाम् अभिघारयत्य् उपेतरा यच्छन्ति ।
11.5.70.m: He pours an offering over the omentum of the one for Agni with a ladle libation; they hold out the others near it. Then, having performed with the prompting for svāhā-offerings, having sprinkled the speckled butter with the residue, he sprinkles the omentum of the one for Agni; they hold out the others near it.

11.5.70.s: atha purastād svāhākṛtim̐ sruvāhutim̐ hutvāthaiteṣāṃ nānādevatyānāṃ paśūnām anubrūhi preṣya | iti vapābhiś carati |
11.5.70.d: अथ पुरस्ताद् स्वाहाकृतिँ स्रुवाहुतिँ हुत्वाथैतेषां नानादेवत्यानां पशूनाम् अनुब्रूहि प्रेष्य । इति वपाभिश् चरति ।
11.5.70.m: Then, having offered a ladle libation as an offering before the svāhā-call, he performs with the omenta of these animal victims dedicated to various deities with 'Recite' [and] 'Prompt.'

11.5.70.s: athaiteṣām̐ samānadevatyānāṃ paśūnāṃ mukhyasya vapām̐ samavalumpann āha "prajāpataye" | ity upām̐śu "chāgānāṃ vapānāṃ medaso 'vadīyamānasyānubrūhi" | ity uccair yāvatīḥ sruk saṃbhavati |
11.5.70.d: अथैतेषाँ समानदेवत्यानां पशूनां मुख्यस्य वपाँ समवलुम्पन्न् आह "प्रजापतये" । इत्य् उपाँशु "छागानां वपानां मेदसो ऽवदीयमानस्यानुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैर् यावतीः स्रुक् संभवति ।
11.5.70.m: Then, cutting off the omentum of the principal one among these animal victims dedicated to the same deity, he says: ''To Prajāpati' in a low voice, and loudly: 'Recite for the fat of the omenta of the goats being cut off,' as many as the ladle can hold.
Then they raise the others up with a vessel or with an offering tray.

11.5.70.s: dvir abhighārayati | atyākramyāśrāvyāha "prajāpataye" | ity upām̐śu "chāgānāṃ vapāṃ medaḥ prasthitaṃ preṣya" | ity uccais |
11.5.70.d: द्विर् अभिघारयति । अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह "प्रजापतये" । इत्य् उपाँशु "छागानां वपां मेदः प्रस्थितं प्रेष्य" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
11.5.70.m: He sprinkles it twice. Stepping across, having made the call, he says: ''To Prajāpati' in a low voice, and loudly: 'Prompt for the fat of the omentum of the goats set forth.'

11.5.71.s: vaṣaṭkṛte vapā juhoty upām̐śu sārasvatyai vapayā carati |
11.5.71.d: वषट्कृते वपा जुहोत्य् उपाँशु सारस्वत्यै वपया चरति ।
11.5.71.m: When the vaṣaṭ call has been made, he offers the omentum; he proceeds in a low voice with the omentum for Sarasvatī.

11.5.71.s: athopariṣṭātsvāhākṛtim̐ sruvāhutim̐ hutvā vapāśrapaṇīr anuprahṛtya samutkramya cātvāle mārjayante |
11.5.71.d: अथोपरिष्टात्स्वाहाकृतिँ स्रुवाहुतिँ हुत्वा वपाश्रपणीर् अनुप्रहृत्य समुत्क्रम्य चात्वाले मार्जयन्ते ।
11.5.71.m: Then, having offered a ladle libation as an offering after the svāhā-call, having thrown the two omentum-cooking forks into the fire, and having stepped out, they cleanse themselves at the pit.

11.5.71.s: atha paśūn viśāsti "śamitar" ity āha "yan mārutyā anavadānīyaṃ tad abhyardhāc chrapayatāt" | iti |
11.5.71.d: अथ पशून् विशास्ति "शमितर्" इत्य् आह "यन् मारुत्या अनवदानीयं तद् अभ्यर्धाच् छ्रपयतात्" । इति ।
11.5.71.m: Then he instructs regarding the animal victims; he says: 'O slaughterer, cook separately whatever is not to be cut off from the [cow] for the Maruts.'
Then, having offered the oblation to Savitar, they glide forward for the morning pressing.

11.6.71.s: atha sāvitram̐ hutvā prasarpanti mādhyaṃdināya savanāya devī dvārau | iti |
11.6.71.d: अथ सावित्रँ हुत्वा प्रसर्पन्ति माध्यंदिनाय सवनाय देवी द्वारौ । इति ।
11.6.71.m: Then, having offered the oblation to Savitar, they glide forward for the midday pressing with: 'O divine doors...'

11.6.71.s: ata evordhvena saṃprasṛptān viditvādhvaryuḥ prāṅ āyann āha cātvāle rathacakraṃ niminuta rathavāhane ratham ādhatta | aśvān palpūlayata yad dāsyann asi taddakṣiṇata upasthāpaya | abhiṣotāra eta hvayata grāvastutam ehi yajamāna | iti
11.6.71.d: अत एवोर्ध्वेन संप्रसृप्तान् विदित्वाध्वर्युः प्राङ् आयन्न् आह चात्वाले रथचक्रं निमिनुत रथवाहने रथम् आधत्त । अश्वान् पल्पूलयत यद् दास्यन्न् असि तद्दक्षिणत उपस्थापय । अभिषोतार एत ह्वयत ग्रावस्तुतम् एहि यजमान । इति
11.6.71.m: Knowing that they have glided forward by the higher way from here, the adhvaryu priest, going east, says: 'Fix the chariot-wheel in the pit; place the chariot on the chariot-stand; wash the horses; place in the south whatever you intend to give; come, O pressers; call the praiser of the pressing stones; come, O sacrificer.'
The pressing is in the established manner. The soma-cups are drawn in the established manner.

11.6.71.s: samānaṃ karmāgrayaṇād grahād āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhītvā ṣoḍaśinam abhigṛhṇāti | indram id dharī vahatas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine | iti |
11.6.71.d: समानं कर्माग्रयणाद् ग्रहाद् आग्रयणं गृहीत्वा षोडशिनम् अभिगृह्णाति । इन्द्रम् इद् धरी वहतस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने । इति ।
11.6.71.m: The procedure is the same up to the āgrayaṇa cup. Having drawn the āgrayaṇa cup, he draws additionally the ṣoḍaśin cup. Having recited, 'The two bay horses carry Indra...', [he draws it with,] 'You are taken with a base: I draw you agreeable to Indra of the sixteen.' Having wiped it, he deposits it with, 'This is your base; for Indra of the sixteen [thee].'

11.6.72.m: Then he draws the ukthya cup. The procedure is the same up to the dakṣiṇā offerings.

11.6.72.s: dākṣiṇāni hoṣyan yācaty ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ srucaṃ vāsas
11.6.72.d: दाक्षिणानि होष्यन् याचत्य् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ स्रुचं वासस्
11.6.72.m: About to offer the dakṣiṇā offerings, he asks for the ghee-pot together with the dipping spoon, the offering ladle, and a garment.

11.6.72.s: tasyaitasya vasanasyāntamāyāṃ daśāyāṃ niṣkarajjuḥ pragrathitā bhavati |
11.6.72.d: तस्यैतस्य वसनस्यान्तमायां दशायां निष्करज्जुः प्रग्रथिता भवति ।
11.6.72.m: To the outermost fringe of this garment, a string of gold ornaments is tied.

11.6.72.s: etat samādāyāha | ehi yajamāna | iti | uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ parītyottareṇa sadaḥ parītyāgreṇa śālāṃ tiṣṭhate pratiprasthātra etāni śastrāṇi prayacchati |
11.6.72.d: एतत् समादायाह । एहि यजमान । इति । उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं परीत्योत्तरेण सदः परीत्याग्रेण शालां तिष्ठते प्रतिप्रस्थात्र एतानि शस्त्राणि प्रयच्छति ।
11.6.72.m: Taking this along, he says, 'Come, O sacrificer.' Walking round to the north of the āgnīdhrīya fire and to the north of the sadas, he stands in front of the hall and hands over these recitations to the pratiprasthātṛ priest.

11.6.72.s: ratha eṣa dakṣiṇe śroṇyante rathavāhana āhito bhavati tam upāvaharati | indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghnas tvayāyaṃ vṛtraṃ vadhyāt | iti |
11.6.72.d: रथ एष दक्षिणे श्रोण्यन्ते रथवाहन आहितो भवति तम् उपावहरति । इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस् त्वयायं वृत्रं वध्यात् । इति ।
11.6.72.m: This chariot is placed on the chariot-stand at the southern hip-corner. He brings it down with: 'You are Indra's bolt, slaying Vṛtra; through you may he slay Vṛtra.'

11.6.72.s: athainaṃ dhūrgṛhītam antarvedy abhyavavartayanti vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīm aditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe yasyām idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa tasyāṃ no devaḥ savitā dharma sāviṣat | iti |
11.6.72.d: अथैनं धूर्गृहीतम् अन्तर्वेद्य् अभ्यववर्तयन्ति वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीम् अदितिं नाम वचसा करामहे यस्याम् इदं विश्वं भुवनम् आविवेश तस्यां नो देवः सविता धर्म साविषत् । इति ।
11.6.72.m: Then, holding it by the pole, they roll it forward into the vedi with: 'Now in the impulse of vigor we invoke with our speech the mother, the great one, named Aditi, into whom this entire universe has entered; upon her may the god Savitar inspire order for us.'

11.6.72.s: athāpsv aśvān palpūlayati | apsv antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam apām uta praśastiṣv aśvā bhavatha vājinas | iti |
11.6.72.d: अथाप्स्व् अश्वान् पल्पूलयति । अप्स्व् अन्तर् अमृतम् अप्सु भेषजम् अपाम् उत प्रशस्तिष्व् अश्वा भवथ वाजिनस् । इति ।
11.6.72.m: Then he washes the horses in water with: 'In the waters is immortality, in the waters is medicine; and in the praises of the waters, O horses, become prize-winning.'

11.6.72.s: atha dakṣiṇaṃ yogyaṃ yunakti vāyur vā tvā manur vā tvā gandharvāḥ saptavim̐śatiḥ | te agre aśvam āyuñjan te asmiñ javam ādadhus | iti |
11.6.72.d: अथ दक्षिणं योग्यं युनक्ति वायुर् वा त्वा मनुर् वा त्वा गन्धर्वाः सप्तविँशतिः । ते अग्रे अश्वम् आयुञ्जन् ते अस्मिञ् जवम् आदधुस् । इति ।
11.6.72.m: Then he yokes the right-hand draught-horse with: 'Either Vāyu, or Manu, or the twenty-seven Gandharvas / they first yoked the horse; they placed speed in him.'

11.6.73.s: athāsya pṛṣṭhaṃ marmṛjyate | apāṃ napād āśuheman ya ūrmiḥ kakudmān pratūrtir vājasātamas tenāyaṃ vājam̐ set | iti |
11.6.73.d: अथास्य पृष्ठं मर्मृज्यते । अपां नपाद् आशुहेमन् य ऊर्मिः ककुद्मान् प्रतूर्तिर् वाजसातमस् तेनायं वाजँ सेत् । इति ।
11.6.73.m: Then he strokes its back with: 'Child of the Waters, swift-impelling, the wave that is hump-backed, darting forward, winning the most vigor—by that may this one win vigor.'

11.6.73.s: evam evottaraṃ yogyaṃ yunakti tasyaivam evottarataḥ praṣṭim upaniyunakti tayor evam eva pṛṣṭhe marmṛjyata
11.6.73.d: एवम् एवोत्तरं योग्यं युनक्ति तस्यैवम् एवोत्तरतः प्रष्टिम् उपनियुनक्ति तयोर् एवम् एव पृष्ठे मर्मृज्यत
11.6.73.m: In the very same way he yokes the left draught-horse. In the very same way he attaches an outrunner horse on its left side. In the very same way he strokes the backs of both.

11.6.73.s: etasya yogam anu sarvam āṇivad yujyate | adhikakṣyān hastinaḥ kurvanti
11.6.73.d: एतस्य योगम् अनु सर्वम् आणिवद् युज्यते । अधिकक्ष्यान् हस्तिनः कुर्वन्ति
11.6.73.m: Following the yoking of this one, everything with linchpins is yoked. They equip elephants with girths.

11.6.73.s: praveṣṭayanti vāsobhārān vasanānāṃ daśāsu niṣkarajjūḥ pragrathnanti
11.6.73.d: प्रवेष्टयन्ति वासोभारान् वसनानां दशासु निष्करज्जूः प्रग्रथ्नन्ति
11.6.73.m: They roll up bundles of garments; they tie strings of gold ornaments to the fringes of the garments.

11.6.73.s: pūgaśo dakṣiṇā āyātayati | atha saurībhyām ṛgbhyāṃ gārhapatye juhoti
11.6.73.d: पूगशो दक्षिणा आयातयति । अथ सौरीभ्याम् ऋग्भ्यां गार्हपत्ये जुहोति
11.6.73.m: He arranges the sacrificial gifts in groups. Then he offers two libations into the gārhapatya fire with two solar verses.
He offers into the āgnīdhra fire with a verse containing the word 'lead' (nī-).

11.6.73.s: sṛjyante dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāpathena sa yat kiṃcid dadāti hiraṇyamukham eva dadāti |
11.6.73.d: सृज्यन्ते दक्षिणा दक्षिणापथेन स यत् किंचिद् ददाति हिरण्यमुखम् एव ददाति ।
11.6.73.m: The sacrificial gifts are led along the path of gifts. Whatever he gives, he gives it with gold in the foreground.

11.6.73.s: atha vāsām̐s anām̐si anām̐si yuktāni goaśvam̐ hastipuruṣam antatas |
11.6.73.d: अथ वासाँस् अनाँसि अनाँसि युक्तानि गोअश्वँ हस्तिपुरुषम् अन्ततस् ।
11.6.73.m: Then garments, carts, carts yoked, cattle and horses, elephants and men at the end.

11.6.73.s: adattā evaite rathā ativartante naite 'nyasya santa ājiṃ dhāvanti
11.6.73.d: अदत्ता एवैते रथा अतिवर्तन्ते नैते ऽन्यस्य सन्त आजिं धावन्ति
11.6.73.m: These chariots roll past without being given away. Belonging to no one else, they run the race.

11.6.73.s: manasaiva svaratham adhvaryave dadāti manasā samanudiśya dakṣiṇās
11.6.73.d: मनसैव स्वरथम् अध्वर्यवे ददाति मनसा समनुदिश्य दक्षिणास्
11.6.73.m: Mentally alone he gives his own chariot to the adhvaryu priest, having assigned the sacrificial gifts in mind.

11.6.73.s: tribhir marutvatīyaiś carati sīdanti nārāśam̐sā āpyāyitā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyāpālambam adho'dho māhendrāya ||
11.6.73.d: त्रिभिर् मरुत्वतीयैश् चरति सीदन्ति नाराशँसा आप्यायिता दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्यापालम्बम् अधोऽधो माहेन्द्राय ॥
11.6.73.m: He proceeds with the three Marutvatīya offerings. The nārāśaṃsa cups, being swelled, are placed beneath the support of the southern havirdhāna cart, one below the other, for the Māhendra cup.

11.7.74.s: atha yācati naivāram̐ saptadaśaśarāvam | sa eṣa kṣīre śṛto bhavati
11.7.74.d: अथ याचति नैवारँ सप्तदशशरावम् । स एष क्षीरे शृतो भवति
11.7.74.m: Then he asks for the seventeen-saucer dish of wild rice. That is cooked in milk.

11.7.74.s: tena carati bṛhaspataye 'nubrūhi bṛhaspatiṃ yaja | iti
11.7.74.d: तेन चरति बृहस्पतये ऽनुब्रूहि बृहस्पतिं यज । इति
11.7.74.m: He proceeds with it: 'Recite for Bṛhaspati,' 'Sacrifice for Bṛhaspati.'

11.7.74.s: tam aniṣṭasviṣṭakṛtam apidhāya prajñātaṃ nidadhāti | athāsyaitat purastād evaudumbare droṇe sarvauṣadhaṃ dadhnājyena samudāyutaṃ bhavati
11.7.74.d: तम् अनिष्टस्विष्टकृतम् अपिधाय प्रज्ञातं निदधाति । अथास्यैतत् पुरस्ताद् एवौदुम्बरे द्रोणे सर्वौषधं दध्नाज्येन समुदायुतं भवति
11.7.74.m: Having covered it before offering to the Sviṣṭakṛt, he deposits it in a known place. Now, prior to this, an all-herb mixture has been stirred together with curd and ghee in an udumbara trough.

11.7.74.s: tasyaudumbareṇa sruveṇopaghātam̐ saptānnahomāñ juhoti vājasyemaṃ prasavaḥ suṣuve agre | iti |
11.7.74.d: तस्यौदुम्बरेण स्रुवेणोपघातँ सप्तान्नहोमाञ् जुहोति वाजस्येमं प्रसवः सुषुवे अग्रे । इति ।
11.7.74.m: Taking portions of it with an udumbara dipping-spoon, he offers seven food-oblations with: 'This impulse of vigor brought forth in the beginning...'

11.7.74.s: abhiṣekāya prarekaṃ pariśinaṣṭi | athainam apidhāya prajñātaṃ nidadhāti |
11.7.74.d: अभिषेकाय प्ररेकं परिशिनष्टि । अथैनम् अपिधाय प्रज्ञातं निदधाति ।
11.7.74.m: He leaves behind a remainder for the consecration. Then, covering it, he deposits it in a known place.

11.7.74.s: atha purastād abhiṣkasya ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti | agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā | iti |
11.7.74.d: अथ पुरस्ताद् अभिष्कस्य षट् पार्थानि जुहोति । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहा । इति ।
11.7.74.m: Then, before the consecration, he offers the six Pārtha offerings with: 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!'
Then he spreads out a black antelope skin on the seat of the sacrificer, with its neck to the east and its fleece facing upwards.

11.7.74.s: tad yajamānaṃ prāñcam upaveśya suvarṇarajatābhyām̐ rukmābhyāṃ paryupāsya sarvauṣadhena purastāt pratyañcaṃ abhiṣiñcati
11.7.74.d: तद् यजमानं प्राञ्चम् उपवेश्य सुवर्णरजताभ्याँ रुक्माभ्यां पर्युपास्य सर्वौषधेन पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं अभिषिञ्चति
11.7.74.m: Having seated the sacrificer there facing east, having surrounded him with two gold and silver plates, he consecrates him from the front facing west with the all-herb mixture.

11.7.74.s: śīrṣato 'bhiṣiñcaty ā mukhād anvavasrāvayati devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām̐ sarasvatyai vāco yantur yantreṇāgnes tvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmīndrasya tvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi bṛhaspates tvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi | iti
11.7.74.d: शीर्षतो ऽभिषिञ्चत्य् आ मुखाद् अन्ववस्रावयति देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याँ सरस्वत्यै वाचो यन्तुर् यन्त्रेणाग्नेस् त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीन्द्रस्य त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि बृहस्पतेस् त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि । इति
11.7.74.m: He pours it over him from the head, letting it flow down to his face, with: 'At the impulse of the god Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, with the restraint of Sarasvatī, the restrainer of speech, I consecrate you with the universal sovereignty of Agni; I consecrate you with the universal sovereignty of Indra; I consecrate you with the universal sovereignty of Bṛhaspati.'

11.7.74.s: samunmṛṣṭe samutkrośanti | abhyaṣecy ayam asāv āmuṣyāyaṇo 'muṣya putro 'muṣya pautro 'muṣya naptā vājapeyena | iti |
11.7.74.d: समुन्मृष्टे समुत्क्रोशन्ति । अभ्यषेच्य् अयम् असाव् आमुष्यायणो ऽमुष्य पुत्रो ऽमुष्य पौत्रो ऽमुष्य नप्ता वाजपेयेन । इति ।
11.7.74.m: When he wipes himself off, they shout out together: 'Consecrated is this one, so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, son of so-and-so, grandson of so-and-so, great-grandson of so-and-so, through the Vājapeya!'

11.7.74.s: atha bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti vācaṃ visṛjate
11.7.74.d: अथ भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति वाचं विसृजते
11.7.74.m: Then he releases his speech with: 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar.'

11.7.74.s: dvābhyāṃ mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe gāyatrān viṣṇukramān kramate |
11.7.74.d: द्वाभ्यां मुखं विमृष्टे गायत्रान् विष्णुक्रमान् क्रमते ।
11.7.74.m: He wipes his face with two [verses]. He strides the Viṣṇu strides in gāyatrī metre.

11.7.74.s: athopariṣṭād abhiṣekasya ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti | indrāya svāhā ghoṣāya svāhā | iti
11.7.74.d: अथोपरिष्टाद् अभिषेकस्य षट् पार्थानि जुहोति । इन्द्राय स्वाहा घोषाय स्वाहा । इति
11.7.74.m: Then, after the consecration, he offers the six Pārtha offerings with: 'To Indra svāhā! To Ghoṣa svāhā!'

11.7.75.s: dvādaśa bhūtānām aveṣṭīr juhoti pṛthivyai svāhāntarikṣāya svāhā | iti |
11.7.75.d: द्वादश भूतानाम् अवेष्टीर् जुहोति पृथिव्यै स्वाहान्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा । इति ।
11.7.75.m: He offers the twelve offerings to the beings with: 'To the earth svāhā! To the intermediate space svāhā!'
At this point he proceeds with the Sviṣṭakṛt of this offering to Bṛhaspati.

11.7.75.s: athainaṃ ādāyāntareṇa cātvālotkarāv undaṅṅ upaniṣkrāmati | uttarata ete rathā yuktās tiṣṭhanti
11.7.75.d: अथैनं आदायान्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उन्दङ्ङ् उपनिष्क्रामति । उत्तरत एते रथा युक्तास् तिष्ठन्ति
11.7.75.m: Then, taking it, he goes out towards the north between the pit and the rubbish heap. To the north these chariots stand yoked.

11.7.75.s: tad etān yajuryujo 'śvān avaghrāpayati vājino vājajito vājam̐ sariṣyanto vājaṃ jeṣyanto bṛhaspater bhāgam avajighrata | iti |
11.7.75.d: तद् एतान् यजुर्युजो ऽश्वान् अवघ्रापयति वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजँ सरिष्यन्तो वाजं जेष्यन्तो बृहस्पतेर् भागम् अवजिघ्रत । इति ।
11.7.75.m: There he makes these horses, yoked with formulas, sniff it with: 'Prize-winning, winners of the prize, about to run for the prize, about to win the prize, sniff the share of Bṛhaspati.'

11.7.75.s: athainam apidhāya prajñātaṃ nidadhāti | atha ratham abhipraiti viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si viṣṇoḥ krāntaṃ asi viṣṇor vikrāntam asi | iti |
11.7.75.d: अथैनम् अपिधाय प्रज्ञातं निदधाति । अथ रथम् अभिप्रैति विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि विष्णोः क्रान्तं असि विष्णोर् विक्रान्तम् असि । इति ।
11.7.75.m: Then, covering it, he deposits it in a known place. Then he approaches the chariot with: 'You are the stride of Viṣṇu; you are the stepped stride of Viṣṇu; you are the wide stride of Viṣṇu.'

11.7.75.s: atha rathasya pakṣasī saṃmṛśati | aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito rathaṃ yau | iti
11.7.75.d: अथ रथस्य पक्षसी संमृशति । अङ्कौ न्यङ्काव् अभितो रथं यौ । इति
11.7.75.m: Then he touches the two sides of the chariot with: 'The two curved hooks on both sides of the chariot...'

11.7.75.s: ratham ātiṣṭhati devasyāham̐ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatinā vājajitā vājaṃ jeṣam iti |
11.7.75.d: रथम् आतिष्ठति देवस्याहँ सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिना वाजजिता वाजं जेषम् इति ।
11.7.75.m: He mounts the chariot with: 'At the impulse of the god Savitar, with Bṛhaspati, the prize-winner, may I win the prize.'
At this time, the brahman priest mounts an erected chariot wheel.

11.7.75.s: tam ata evānumantrayate devasyāham̐ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatihā vājajitā varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākam̐ ruheyam iti |
11.7.75.d: तम् अत एवानुमन्त्रयते देवस्याहँ सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिहा वाजजिता वर्षिष्ठं नाकँ रुहेयम् इति ।
11.7.75.m: From right here he addresses him with: 'At the impulse of the god Savitar, with Bṛhaspati, the prize-winner, may I mount to the highest firmament.'

11.7.75.s: atha yajamānam anvāsthāyojjitīr vācayati | agnir ekākṣareṇa vācam udajayat | iti saptadaśa |
11.7.75.d: अथ यजमानम् अन्वास्थायोज्जितीर् वाचयति । अग्निर् एकाक्षरेण वाचम् उदजयत् । इति सप्तदश ।
11.7.75.m: Then, mounting behind the sacrificer, he makes him recite the seventeen victory-formulas (ujjitis): 'Agni won speech with one syllable...'

11.7.75.s: athāsmā aśvājinīṃ prayacchati | aśvājani vājini vājeṣu vājinīvaty aśvānt samatsu vājaya | iti
11.7.75.d: अथास्मा अश्वाजिनीं प्रयच्छति । अश्वाजनि वाजिनि वाजेषु वाजिनीवत्य् अश्वान्त् समत्सु वाजय । इति
11.7.75.m: Then he hands him the horsewhip with: 'O horsewhip, prize-winning, possessed of prizes in the contests for vigor, urge on the horses in battles.'
With it he touches the horses in the order they were yoked.

11.7.76.s: arvāsi | iti dakṣiṇam | saptir asi | iti madhyamam | vājy asi | ity uttaram athaitān ājisṛto 'vakhyāpayati vājino vājaṃ dhāvata marutāṃ prasave jayata vi yojanā mimīdhvam adhvana skabhnīta kāṣṭhāṃ gacchata | iti |
11.7.76.d: अर्वासि । इति दक्षिणम् । सप्तिर् असि । इति मध्यमम् । वाज्य् असि । इत्य् उत्तरम् अथैतान् आजिसृतो ऽवख्यापयति वाजिनो वाजं धावत मरुतां प्रसवे जयत वि योजना मिमीध्वम् अध्वन स्कभ्नीत काष्ठां गच्छत । इति ।
11.7.76.m: 'You are a courser,' to the right one; 'You are a racehorse,' to the middle one; 'You are a prize-winner,' to the left one. Then he instructs these race-runners: 'Prize-winners, run for the prize! Win at the impulse of the Maruts! Measure out the leagues! Clear the tracks! Reach the goal!'

11.7.76.s: audumbaryeṣā sthūṇā saptadaśasu śamyāpravyādheṣu nimitā tāṃ kāṣṭhety ācakṣate tām ājisṛto 'tītya mā gacchata mo enām aprāpya nivṛtatāntaḥpakṣasam enāṃ kṛtvā savyān avagṛhya dakṣiṇair anuparivartayādhvai mo aprasūtāḥ sarpateti ||
11.7.76.d: औदुम्बर्येषा स्थूणा सप्तदशसु शम्याप्रव्याधेषु निमिता तां काष्ठेत्य् आचक्षते ताम् आजिसृतो ऽतीत्य मा गच्छत मो एनाम् अप्राप्य निवृततान्तःपक्षसम् एनां कृत्वा सव्यान् अवगृह्य दक्षिणैर् अनुपरिवर्तयाध्वै मो अप्रसूताः सर्पतेति ॥
11.7.76.m: This udumbara post is set up at seventeen throws of a yoke-pin. They call that the goal. 'O race-runners, do not run past it, nor turn back without reaching it; having made it your inner axle-side, holding back the left horses, turn around it with the right ones; do not start moving unimpelled.'

11.8.76.s: athāhābhisarpa yajamāna māhendraṃ grahaṃ grahīsyāmīti | anvārabdhe yajamāne māhendraṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti mahām̐ indro ya ojasā | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si mahendrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir mahendrāya tvā | iti
11.8.76.d: अथाहाभिसर्प यजमान माहेन्द्रं ग्रहं ग्रहीस्यामीति । अन्वारब्धे यजमाने माहेन्द्रं ग्रहं गृह्णाति महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि महेन्द्राय त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् महेन्द्राय त्वा । इति
11.8.76.m: Then he says: “Sacrificer, glide forward; I shall draw the Māhendra cup.” While the sacrificer holds on behind, he draws the Māhendra cup, having recited: “Great is Indra, who through his might...”; having wiped it around with: “You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Mahendra,” he sets it down with: “This is your womb; for Mahendra [I take] you.”

11.8.76.s: tad etān pañcaindrān atigrāhyān saha sam̐sādayati |
11.8.76.d: तद् एतान् पञ्चैन्द्रान् अतिग्राह्यान् सह सँसादयति ।
11.8.76.m: Then he sets down these five additional cups for Indra together.

11.8.76.s: athāpa upaspṛśya barhiṣī ādāya vācaṃyamaḥ pratyaṅ drutvā stotram upākaroti
11.8.76.d: अथाप उपस्पृश्य बर्हिषी आदाय वाचंयमः प्रत्यङ् द्रुत्वा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
11.8.76.m: Then, having touched water and taken two stalks of sacrificial grass, keeping silence, having run westward, he introduces the chant.

11.8.77.s: prastute sāmni saṃpraiṣam āha brahman vājinām̐ sāma gaya | ājisṛta ājiṃ dhāvata dundubhīn samāghnata | abhiṣotāro 'bhiṣuṇuta | agnīd āśiraṃ vinayolūkhalam udvādaya pratiprasthātar vāruṇam ekakapālaṃ nirvapa saumyasya viddhi | iti
11.8.77.d: प्रस्तुते साम्नि संप्रैषम् आह ब्रह्मन् वाजिनाँ साम गय । आजिसृत आजिं धावत दुन्दुभीन् समाघ्नत । अभिषोतारो ऽभिषुणुत । अग्नीद् आशिरं विनयोलूखलम् उद्वादय प्रतिप्रस्थातर् वारुणम् एककपालं निर्वप सौम्यस्य विद्धि । इति
11.8.77.m: When the saman has been commenced by the prastotṛ, he issues the directions: “Brahman, sing the saman of the racers! Chariot-racers, run the race! Beat the drums together! Pressers, press [the soma]! Agnīdh, blend the milk mixture; sound the mortar! Pratiprasthātṛ priest, apportion [the cake] on one potsherd for Varuṇa, [and] know what is for the Soma offering!”
They act according to the directions.

11.8.77.s: gāyati brahmā vājinām̐ sāma taṃ ya eva kaśca parikarmy āveṣṭayati
11.8.77.d: गायति ब्रह्मा वाजिनाँ साम तं य एव कश्च परिकर्म्य् आवेष्टयति
11.8.77.m: The brahman priest sings the saman of the racers. Whichever servant it is holds a cloth around him.

11.8.77.s: dhāvanty ājisṛta āghnanti dundubhīn saṃpravadanti vācaḥ
11.8.77.d: धावन्त्य् आजिसृत आघ्नन्ति दुन्दुभीन् संप्रवदन्ति वाचः
11.8.77.m: The chariot-racers run. They beat the drums. Voices sound together.

11.8.77.s: saṃproditā vāco 'numantrayate | indrāya vācaṃ vadatendraṃ vājaṃ jāpayatendro vājam ajayit | iti |
11.8.77.d: संप्रोदिता वाचो ऽनुमन्त्रयते । इन्द्राय वाचं वदतेन्द्रं वाजं जापयतेन्द्रो वाजम् अजयित् । इति ।
11.8.77.m: He addresses the sounding voices with: “Speak the word for Indra! Make Indra win the prize! Indra has won the prize!”

11.8.77.s: atha rathān dhāvato 'numantrayate vājevāje 'vata vājino nas | iti catasṛbhir anucchandasam |
11.8.77.d: अथ रथान् धावतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते वाजेवाजे ऽवत वाजिनो नस् । इति चतसृभिर् अनुच्छन्दसम् ।
11.8.77.m: Then he addresses the running chariots with the four [verses]: “At every prize, help us, racers...”, in accordance with the meter.

11.8.77.s: śāmyanti ghoṣāḥ śastrāya hotre | eṣottamā | iti prāhus | hotuḥ kālāt parāṅ āvartate 'dhvaryur
11.8.77.d: शाम्यन्ति घोषाः शस्त्राय होत्रे । एषोत्तमा । इति प्राहुस् । होतुः कालात् पराङ् आवर्तते ऽध्वर्युर्
11.8.77.m: The sounds cease for the recitation. They say to the hotṛ priest: “This is the last [verse].” From the hotṛ's place, the adhvaryu priest turns away.

11.8.77.d: अभ्य् एनम् आह्वयते होता प्रत्याह्वयते ऽध्वर्युः
11.8.77.m: The hotṛ priest calls upon him; the adhvaryu priest responds to the call.

11.8.77.s: śam̐sati pratigṛṇāti prasiddham ukthaṃ pratigīrya prāṅ etyodyacchata etaṃ māhendraṃ graham
11.8.77.d: शँसति प्रतिगृणाति प्रसिद्धम् उक्थं प्रतिगीर्य प्राङ् एत्योद्यच्छत एतं माहेन्द्रं ग्रहम्
11.8.77.m: He recites. He utters the response. Having responded to the established praise recitation, having gone eastward, they lift up this Māhendra cup.
They lift up the other cups following [it]; they lift up the nārāśaṃsa cups nearby.

11.8.77.s: athāśrāvayati | o śrāvaya | astu śrauṣaṭ | ukthaśā yaja somasya | iti
11.8.77.d: अथाश्रावयति । ओ श्रावय । अस्तु श्रौषट् । उक्थशा यज सोमस्य । इति
11.8.77.m: Then he makes the call: “Make [him] hear!” — “Let it be heard!” — “Reciter of the recitation, offer of the soma!”

11.8.78.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti tad etān pañcaindrān atigrāhyān saha juhvati
11.8.78.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति तद् एतान् पञ्चैन्द्रान् अतिग्राह्यान् सह जुह्वति
11.8.78.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is made, he offers. Then they offer these five additional cups for Indra together.

11.8.78.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvāṣaṭkṛte dvir juhoti tathaiva dvirdvir nārāśam̐sān anuprakampayanti
11.8.78.d: वषट्कृतानुवाषट्कृते द्विर् जुहोति तथैव द्विर्द्विर् नाराशँसान् अनुप्रकम्पयन्ति
11.8.78.m: At the vaṣaṭ call and the second vaṣaṭ call, he offers twice. In the same way, they shake the nārāśaṃsa cups twice each.
Offered twice, the Māhendra cup remains. The chariots arrive.

11.8.78.s: āgatān rathān dṛṣṭvā yācaty ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām | sa yady asmai rathabhreṣam ācakṣata āgnīdhra etāṃ juhoti | uta smāsya dravatas turaṇyatas | ity ubhayenaiva
11.8.78.d: आगतान् रथान् दृष्ट्वा याचत्य् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाम् । स यद्य् अस्मै रथभ्रेषम् आचक्षत आग्नीध्र एतां जुहोति । उत स्मास्य द्रवतस् तुरण्यतस् । इत्य् उभयेनैव
11.8.78.m: Having seen that the chariots have arrived, he asks for the ghee-pot together with the dipping ladle. If they report to him any mishap to a chariot, he offers this [libation] at the āgnīdhra fire with both: “And indeed, of him running swiftly...”

11.8.78.s: rathavimocanīyaṃ juhoti | ā mā vājasya prasavo jagamyāt | iti ||
11.8.78.d: रथविमोचनीयं जुहोति । आ मा वाजस्य प्रसवो जगम्यात् । इति ॥
11.8.78.m: He offers the chariot-unyoking offering with: “May the impulse of the prize come to me!”

11.9.78.s: atha yācati naivāram̐ saptadaśaśarāvam̐ saptadaśa suvarṇāni kṛṣṇalāni hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇam iti |
11.9.78.d: अथ याचति नैवारँ सप्तदशशरावँ सप्तदश सुवर्णानि कृष्णलानि हिरण्यपात्रं मधोः पूर्णम् इति ।
11.9.78.m: Then he asks for: the wild rice [mess] of seventeen platters, seventeen gold kṛṣṇala berries, [and] a golden vessel full of honey.
Having taken this together, he steps out northward between the pit and the rubbish heap.
To the north stand these chariots, yoked.

11.9.78.s: tad etān yajuryujo 'śvān avaghrāpayati vājino vājajito vājam̐ sasṛvām̐so vājaṃ jigivām̐so bṛhaspater bhāge nimṛḍdhvam iti |
11.9.78.d: तद् एतान् यजुर्युजो ऽश्वान् अवघ्रापयति वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजँ ससृवाँसो वाजं जिगिवाँसो बृहस्पतेर् भागे निमृड्ध्वम् इति ।
11.9.78.m: Then he makes these horses yoked with yajus formulas sniff it with: “O racers, prize-winners, who have run for the prize, who have won the prize, be gracious in Bṛhaspati's share!”

11.9.78.s: athainam apidhāya prajñātaṃ nidadhāti | atha rathān vimucyamānān anumantrayate | iyaṃ vaḥ sā satyā saṃdhābhūd yām indreṇa samadhaddhvam iti
11.9.78.d: अथैनम् अपिधाय प्रज्ञातं निदधाति । अथ रथान् विमुच्यमानान् अनुमन्त्रयते । इयं वः सा सत्या संधाभूद् याम् इन्द्रेण समधद्ध्वम् इति
11.9.78.m: Then, having covered it, he sets it down in a recognized place. Then he addresses the chariots being unyoked with: “This was that true covenant of yours, which you made with Indra,”

11.9.78.s: dundubhīn avasyato 'numantrayate | ajījipata vanaspataya indraṃ vājaṃ vimucyadhvam iti
11.9.78.d: दुन्दुभीन् अवस्यतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते । अजीजिपत वनस्पतय इन्द्रं वाजं विमुच्यध्वम् इति
11.9.78.m: He addresses the drums being loosened with: “Trees, you have made Indra win the prize; be loosened!”

11.9.78.s: tad etaṃ yajuryujam̐ rathaṃ vimuñcati yathādattam itarān vyāvartayanti |
11.9.78.d: तद् एतं यजुर्युजँ रथं विमुञ्चति यथादत्तम् इतरान् व्यावर्तयन्ति ।
11.9.78.m: Then he unyokes this chariot yoked with yajus formulas. As they were given, they drive the others away.

11.9.78.s: upasaṃgacchanta enam eta ājisṛtas tebhya ekaikaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ vyutprayacchati
11.9.78.d: उपसंगच्छन्त एनम् एत आजिसृतस् तेभ्य एकैकं कृष्णलं व्युत्प्रयच्छति
11.9.78.m: These chariot-racers assemble by him. To them he distributes one kṛṣṇala each.

11.9.78.s: tāni sārdham̐ samādāya hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇam ity ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati ||
11.9.78.d: तानि सार्धँ समादाय हिरण्यपात्रं मधोः पूर्णम् इत्य् एकधा ब्रह्मण उपहरति ॥
11.9.78.m: Having gathered them together, he brings near the golden vessel full of honey at once for the brahman priest.

11.10.79.s: tad brahmā pratigṛhyopāvarohati | athāhājisṛto dakṣiṇāpathenopātītya dakṣiṇām̐ śroṇim abhiniśrayadhvaṃ mārutā agreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītya dakṣiṇam am̐sam upasam̐śrayadhvam iti
11.10.79.d: तद् ब्रह्मा प्रतिगृह्योपावरोहति । अथाहाजिसृतो दक्षिणापथेनोपातीत्य दक्षिणाँ श्रोणिम् अभिनिश्रयध्वं मारुता अग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्य दक्षिणम् अँसम् उपसँश्रयध्वम् इति
11.10.79.m: The brahman priest accepts it and steps down. Then he says: “Chariot-racers, having gone past along the southern path, lean against the southern buttock [of the altar]; Mārutas, having gone around in front of the āhavanīya fire, lean against the southern shoulder.”
Then they screen them with two sheds.

11.10.79.s: athāha | ehi yajamāna | iti pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādya yajamānam̐ somagrahān upasthāpayati ||
11.10.79.d: अथाह । एहि यजमान । इति पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपाद्य यजमानँ सोमग्रहान् उपस्थापयति ॥
11.10.79.m: Then he says: “Come, sacrificer!” Having made the sacrificer enter the havirdhāna shed through the eastern door, he makes him attend upon the soma-cups,

11.11.79.s: saṃpṛca stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta | iti vipṛca stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta | iti surāgrahān
11.11.79.d: संपृच स्थ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त । इति विपृच स्थ वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्त । इति सुराग्रहान्
11.11.79.m: with: “You are mingling; mingle me with good fortune!” [and] upon the surā-cups with: “You are separating; separate me from evil!”

11.11.79.s: athaitām̐ surām̐ saprarekām ādāyaitām̐ś ca surāgrahān ājisṛdbhya upaharanti
11.11.79.d: अथैताँ सुराँ सप्ररेकाम् आदायैताँश् च सुराग्रहान् आजिसृद्भ्य उपहरन्ति
11.11.79.m: Then, having taken this surā along with its sediment and these surā-cups, they present them to the chariot-racers.

11.11.79.s: tāṃ te pibanto ramamāṇā mahīyamānā āsate |
11.11.79.d: तां ते पिबन्तो रममाणा महीयमाना आसते ।
11.11.79.m: Drinking it, rejoicing, being honored, they sit.

11.11.79.s: atra yan mārutyā anavadānīyaṃ tad ubhayān antareṇa parṇaśākhāsu nyasyati
11.11.79.d: अत्र यन् मारुत्या अनवदानीयं तद् उभयान् अन्तरेण पर्णशाखासु न्यस्यति
11.11.79.m: Here, whatever is not to be portioned out of the victim for the Maruts, that he throws down onto palāśa branches between both groups.
Having shouted out together, they scramble and fight for it.

11.11.79.s: atha yācaty ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvāṃ tārpyaṃ darbhamayam iti | etat samādāyāha | ehi yajamāna | iti |
11.11.79.d: अथ याचत्य् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवां तार्प्यं दर्भमयम् इति । एतत् समादायाह । एहि यजमान । इति ।
11.11.79.m: Then he asks for the ghee-pot together with the dipping ladle, a tārpya garment, [and a garment] made of darbha grass. Having taken this together, he says: “Come, sacrificer!”

11.11.79.s: anvag yajamāno 'nūcī patnī | āhavanīye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne vājaś ca prasavaś ca | iti dvādaśa sruvāhutīs |
11.11.79.d: अन्वग् यजमानो ऽनूची पत्नी । आहवनीये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने वाजश् च प्रसवश् च । इति द्वादश स्रुवाहुतीस् ।
11.11.79.m: The sacrificer [comes] behind; behind [him] the wife. While the sacrificer holds on behind, he offers twelve ladle libations into the āhavanīya fire with: “Prize and impulse...”

11.11.79.s: atha yajamānaṃ tārpyaṃ paridhāpayati kṣatrasyolbam asi | iti kṣatrasya yonir asi | iti darbhamayaṃ patnīm
11.11.79.d: अथ यजमानं तार्प्यं परिधापयति क्षत्रस्योल्बम् असि । इति क्षत्रस्य योनिर् असि । इति दर्भमयं पत्नीम्
11.11.79.m: Then he causes the sacrificer to put on the tārpya garment with: “You are the womb-cover of nobility!” and the wife [to put on] the garment made of darbha grass with: “You are the womb of nobility!”

11.11.80.s: athaitām̐ śritiṃ yajamānāyatanāt prācīṃ vodīcīṃ vā yūpam abhyāyātayati |
11.11.80.d: अथैताँ श्रितिं यजमानायतनात् प्राचीं वोदीचीं वा यूपम् अभ्यायातयति ।
11.11.80.m: Then he extends this ladder from the sacrificer's seat towards the sacrificial post, either eastward or northward.

11.11.80.s: atha jāyām āmantrayate jāya ehi suvo rohāva | iti
11.11.80.d: अथ जायाम् आमन्त्रयते जाय एहि सुवो रोहाव । इति
11.11.80.m: Then he invites his wife: “Wife, come, let us two climb to heaven!”
“Let us indeed climb to heaven!” the other replies.

11.11.80.s: ahaṃ nāv ubhayoḥ suvo rokṣyāmi | iti yajamānas tvaṃ nāv ubhayoḥ suvo roha | iti patnī
11.11.80.d: अहं नाव् उभयोः सुवो रोक्ष्यामि । इति यजमानस् त्वं नाव् उभयोः सुवो रोह । इति पत्नी
11.11.80.m: “I shall climb to heaven for both of us,” says the sacrificer. “Climb to heaven for both of us,” says the wife.

11.11.80.s: tāṃ daśabhiḥ kalpai rohati | āyur yajñena kalpatām iti |
11.11.80.d: तां दशभिः कल्पै रोहति । आयुर् यज्ञेन कल्पताम् इति ।
11.11.80.m: He climbs it with the ten formulas: “May life-breath succeed through sacrifice...”

11.11.80.s: āntaṃ gatvā bāhū udgṛhṇāti suvar devām̐ aganmāmṛtā abhūma prajāpateḥ prajā abhūma | iti |
11.11.80.d: आन्तं गत्वा बाहू उद्गृह्णाति सुवर् देवाँ अगन्मामृता अभूम प्रजापतेः प्रजा अभूम । इति ।
11.11.80.m: Having reached the end, he stretches up his arms with: “We have gone to heaven, to the gods; we have become immortal; we have become Prajāpati's offspring!”

11.11.80.s: athemaṃ lokaṃ pratyavekṣate sam ahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajā sam aham̐ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ mayā rāyaspoṣas | iti |
11.11.80.d: अथेमं लोकं प्रत्यवेक्षते सम् अहं प्रजया सं मया प्रजा सम् अहँ रायस्पोषेण सं मया रायस्पोषस् । इति ।
11.11.80.m: Then he looks down at this world with: “May I be united with offspring, offspring with me; may I be united with increase of wealth, increase of wealth with me!”

11.11.80.s: athainām upāvarohati sa yāvati manyata etāvati modāpsyanti | iti
11.11.80.d: अथैनाम् उपावरोहति स यावति मन्यत एतावति मोदाप्स्यन्ति । इति
11.11.80.m: Then he descends it: “As far as he thinks: ‘At this distance they will not reach me’.”
Then they strike him with leaf-bags [of salty soil].

11.12.80.s: annāya tvā | iti purastād adhvaryur annādyāya tvā | iti dakṣiṇato brahmā vājāya tvā | iti paścād dhotā vājajityāyai tvā | ity udgātottarato
11.12.80.d: अन्नाय त्वा । इति पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युर् अन्नाद्याय त्वा । इति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा वाजाय त्वा । इति पश्चाद् धोता वाजजित्यायै त्वा । इत्य् उद्गातोत्तरतो
11.12.80.m: “For food, to you!” [says] the adhvaryu priest from the east; “For the eating of food, to you!” the brahman priest from the south; “For the prize, to you!” the hotṛ priest from the west; “For winning the prize, to you!” the udgātṛ priest from the north.

11.12.80.s: yady u vā ete na kāmayante 'dhvaryur eva purastād dhanti dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātā paścād āgnīdhra unnetottaratas
11.12.80.d: यद्य् उ वा एते न कामयन्ते ऽध्वर्युर् एव पुरस्ताद् धन्ति दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पश्चाद् आग्नीध्र उन्नेतोत्तरतस्
11.12.80.m: Or if these do not wish to do so, the adhvaryu priest alone strikes from the east, the pratiprasthātṛ priest from the south, the āgnīdhra from the west, the unnetṛ priest from the north.

11.12.81.m: The division among them is just like that of the drums.

11.12.81.s: atrāsmai pratyavarohaṇata āsandīṃ nidadhāti tasyāṃ bastājinam āstṛṇāti bastājine śatamānam̐ hiraṇyam
11.12.81.d: अत्रास्मै प्रत्यवरोहणत आसन्दीं निदधाति तस्यां बस्ताजिनम् आस्तृणाति बस्ताजिने शतमानँ हिरण्यम्
11.12.81.m: Here he places a wicker throne-stool for him below his descent. On it he spreads out a goat skin; on the goat skin, a gold piece of one hundred mānas weight.

11.12.81.s: atha dakṣiṇaṃ pādam̐ hiraṇya upāvarohati | amṛtam asi | iti
11.12.81.d: अथ दक्षिणं पादँ हिरण्य उपावरोहति । अमृतम् असि । इति
11.12.81.m: Then he steps down with his right foot upon the gold [piece], with: "You are immortality."

11.12.81.s: puṣṭir asi prajananam asi | iti savyaṃ bastājine |
11.12.81.d: पुष्टिर् असि प्रजननम् असि । इति सव्यं बस्ताजिने ।
11.12.81.m: [He steps down] with the left [foot] upon the goat-skin, with: "You are nourishment, you are procreation."

11.12.81.s: athainam etayāsandyā sada āvahanti | ā vā vrajati |
11.12.81.d: अथैनम् एतयासन्द्या सद आवहन्ति । आ वा व्रजति ।
11.12.81.m: Then they carry him in this chair to the sadas shed; or else he walks [there].

11.12.81.s: anvāyanty enam ete camasā atraitasya bārhaspatyasyeḍām upahvayata
11.12.81.d: अन्वायन्त्य् एनम् एते चमसा अत्रैतस्य बार्हस्पत्यस्येडाम् उपह्वयत
11.12.81.m: These goblets follow him. There he invites the iḍā of this [animal sacrifice] to Bṛhaspati.

11.12.81.s: iḍopahūtaṃ māhendram̐ hotā caivādhvaryuś ca saṃbhakṣayato narāśam̐sapītena nārāśam̐sān
11.12.81.d: इडोपहूतं माहेन्द्रँ होता चैवाध्वर्युश् च संभक्षयतो नराशँसपीतेन नाराशँसान्
11.12.81.m: Both the hotṛ priest and the adhvaryu priest consume the māhendra cup invited to the iḍā, and the nārāśaṃsa cups with the [call of] "drunk by Narāśaṃsa".

11.12.81.s: atraiteṣām atigrāhyāṇāṃ mukhye pātre sam̐srāvān samavanīya yajamāna eva pratyakṣaṃ bhakṣayati |
11.12.81.d: अत्रैतेषाम् अतिग्राह्याणां मुख्ये पात्रे सँस्रावान् समवनीय यजमान एव प्रत्यक्षं भक्षयति ।
11.12.81.m: There, having poured together the residues of these atigrāhya cups into the principal vessel, the sacrificer alone consumes [them] directly.

11.12.81.s: api vainān sarvaśa eva camaseṣu vyavanīya bhakṣayeyur ity etad aparam |
11.12.81.d: अपि वैनान् सर्वश एव चमसेषु व्यवनीय भक्षयेयुर् इत्य् एतद् अपरम् ।
11.12.81.m: Or else they may consume them having poured them out completely into the goblets—this is the alternative.
Having mutually invited each other, these three consume only the hotṛ priest's goblet.

11.12.81.s: yathācamasaṃ camasān hinva me | ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśante
11.12.81.d: यथाचमसं चमसान् हिन्व मे । इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशन्ते
11.12.81.m: [They consume] the goblets according to their respective goblets. They touch themselves, with: "Invigorate my..."
They do not swell the goblets. Having consumed everything, they cleanse themselves.

11.12.82.s: atha | indrāya tvendrāya tvā | ity evaṃ tribhir ukthyaparyāyaiś carati
11.12.82.d: अथ । इन्द्राय त्वेन्द्राय त्वा । इत्य् एवं त्रिभिर् उक्थ्यपर्यायैश् चरति
11.12.82.m: Then he proceeds with the three ukthya-rounds, with: "To Indra you! To Indra you!"

11.13.82.s: atha sāvitam̐ hutvā prasarpanti tṛtīyasavanāya prasiddham ādityagraheṇa caritvāgrayaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti |
11.13.82.d: अथ सावितँ हुत्वा प्रसर्पन्ति तृतीयसवनाय प्रसिद्धम् आदित्यग्रहेण चरित्वाग्रयणं गृह्णाति ।
11.13.82.m: Then, having offered the libation to Savitar, they creep forth for the third pressing. Having proceeded as prescribed with the Āditya cup, he draws the āgrayaṇa cup.

11.13.82.s: atha ṣoḍaśinam abhigṛhṇāti | asāvi soma indra te | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine | iti |
11.13.82.d: अथ षोडशिनम् अभिगृह्णाति । असावि सोम इन्द्र ते । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा षोडशिने । इति ।
11.13.82.m: Then he draws the ṣoḍaśin cup: having recited, "The soma has been pressed, O Indra, for you," with: "You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Indra, the ṣoḍaśin," having wiped it around, he sets it down, with: "This is your womb; for Indra, the ṣoḍaśin!"
Then he draws the ukthya cup. The rite is identical up to the pavamāna chant.

11.13.82.s: pavamānena caritvā sve dhāmam paśubhiś carati
11.13.82.d: पवमानेन चरित्वा स्वे धामम् पशुभिश् चरति
11.13.82.m: Having proceeded with the pavamāna chant, he proceeds with the animal victims in their own place.

11.13.82.s: teṣāṃ nānā manotā nānā devatā nānā pratyabhimarśanā nānā vasāhomāḥ samāno vanaspatiḥ samānaḥ sviṣṭakṛtpraiṣavān samānīḍā samānyo diśo
11.13.82.d: तेषां नाना मनोता नाना देवता नाना प्रत्यभिमर्शना नाना वसाहोमाः समानो वनस्पतिः समानः स्विष्टकृत्प्रैषवान् समानीडा समान्यो दिशो
11.13.82.m: Of them, the manotā hymns are distinct, the deities are distinct, the touchings are distinct, the omentum offerings are distinct; the sacrificial post (vanaspati) is common, the order for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering is common, the iḍā is common, the quarters are common.

11.13.82.s: nānā diśa ity eke samānaṃ karmā dhruvavadbhyaś camasebhyo
11.13.82.d: नाना दिश इत्य् एके समानं कर्मा ध्रुववद्भ्यश् चमसेभ्यो
11.13.82.m: "The quarters are distinct," say some. The rite is identical up to the goblets containing the dhruva.

11.13.82.s: dhruvavadbhiś camasaiś caritvā tirbhir ukthyaparyāyaiś carati | indrāvaruṇābhyām indrābṛhaspatibhyām indrāviṣṇubhyām iti |
11.13.82.d: ध्रुववद्भिश् चमसैश् चरित्वा तिर्भिर् उक्थ्यपर्यायैश् चरति । इन्द्रावरुणाभ्याम् इन्द्राबृहस्पतिभ्याम् इन्द्राविष्णुभ्याम् इति ।
11.13.82.m: Having proceeded with the goblets containing the dhruva, he proceeds with three ukthya-rounds, with: "To Indra and Varuṇa," "To Indra and Bṛhaspati," "To Indra and Viṣṇu."

11.13.82.s: atha prāṅ āyann āha hotuś camasam anūnnayadhvam unnetaḥ sarvaśa eva rājānam unnaya mātirīricas | iti
11.13.82.d: अथ प्राङ् आयन्न् आह होतुश् चमसम् अनून्नयध्वम् उन्नेतः सर्वश एव राजानम् उन्नय मातिरीरिचस् । इति
11.13.82.m: Then, advancing eastward, he says: "Fill up the hotṛ priest's goblet! O unnetṛ priest, fill up King Soma completely! Do not leave any excess!"

11.13.82.s: hotṛcamasam eva prathamam unnayanti yathopapādam itarān
11.13.82.d: होतृचमसम् एव प्रथमम् उन्नयन्ति यथोपपादम् इतरान्
11.13.82.m: They fill up the hotṛ priest's goblet first, and the others as they present themselves.
Having filled King Soma completely, they place them together on the high altar.

11.13.82.s: tad etān prājāpatyān saha sam̐sādayanti | athāpa upaspṛśya barhiṣī ādāya vācaṃyamaḥ pratyaṅ drutvā stotram upākaroti
11.13.82.d: तद् एतान् प्राजापत्यान् सह सँसादयन्ति । अथाप उपस्पृश्य बर्हिषी आदाय वाचंयमः प्रत्यङ् द्रुत्वा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
11.13.82.m: They set down together these [cups] belonging to Prajāpati. Then, having touched water and taken two blades of sacrificial grass, keeping silence, having run westward, he introduces the chant.

11.13.83.s: stuvate tad etad bṛhatṣamaikavim̐śaṃ vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu kurvanti
11.13.83.d: स्तुवते तद् एतद् बृहत्षमैकविँशं वैष्णवीषु शिपिविष्टवतीषु कुर्वन्ति
11.13.83.m: They chant. They perform this bṛhat saman on twenty-one [verses], on [verses] addressed to Viṣṇu that contain the word śipiviṣṭa.

11.13.83.s: hotre | eṣottamā | iti prāhus | hotuḥ kālāt parāṅ āvartate 'dhvaryur
11.13.83.d: होत्रे । एषोत्तमा । इति प्राहुस् । होतुः कालात् पराङ् आवर्तते ऽध्वर्युर्
11.13.83.m: They say to the hotṛ priest: "This is the last [verse]." From the place of the hotṛ priest, the adhvaryu priest turns away.

11.13.83.d: अभ्य् एनम् आह्वयते होता प्रत्याह्वयते ऽध्वर्युः
11.13.83.m: The hotṛ priest addresses him; the adhvaryu priest responds to the address.

11.13.83.s: śam̐sati pratigṛṇāti prasiddham ukthaṃ pratigīrya prāṅ etyodyacchata etam̐ hotṛcamasam
11.13.83.d: शँसति प्रतिगृणाति प्रसिद्धम् उक्थं प्रतिगीर्य प्राङ् एत्योद्यच्छत एतँ होतृचमसम्
11.13.83.m: He recites. [The adhvaryu] utters the response. Having responded to the recitation in the prescribed manner, coming eastward, he lifts up this hotṛ priest's goblet.

11.13.83.s: anūdyacchanta itarān upodyacchante camasān athāśrāvayati | o śrāvaya | astu śrauṣaṭ | ukthaśā yaja somānām iti
11.13.83.d: अनूद्यच्छन्त इतरान् उपोद्यच्छन्ते चमसान् अथाश्रावयति । ओ श्रावय । अस्तु श्रौषट् । उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति
11.13.83.m: [The others] lift up the other [goblets] in turn; they raise the goblets. Then he makes the call: "Make call!" "May it be heard!" "Reciter of the uktha, sacrifice of the somas!"

11.13.83.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti tad etān prājāpatyān saha juhvati vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte dvir juhoti
11.13.83.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति तद् एतान् प्राजापत्यान् सह जुह्वति वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते द्विर् जुहोति
11.13.83.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, he offers. They offer together these [cups] belonging to Prajāpati. When the vaṣaṭ call and the subsequent vaṣaṭ call are uttered, he offers twice.

11.13.83.s: tathaiva dvirdviḥ sarvām̐ś camasāñ juhvati | atha bhakṣaiḥ pratyañca ādravanty anusavanabhakṣas | prajāpatinā pītasya | iti |
11.13.83.d: तथैव द्विर्द्विः सर्वाँश् चमसाञ् जुह्वति । अथ भक्षैः प्रत्यञ्च आद्रवन्त्य् अनुसवनभक्षस् । प्रजापतिना पीतस्य । इति ।
11.13.83.m: In the very same manner, they offer all the goblets twice each. Then, with the portions to be consumed, they run westward, with the consumption formula of the pressing: "Of that drunk by Prajāpati..."

11.13.83.s: atraiteṣāṃ prājāpatyānāṃ mukhye pātre sam̐srāvān samavanīya yajamāna eva pratyakṣaṃ bhakṣayati |
11.13.83.d: अत्रैतेषां प्राजापत्यानां मुख्ये पात्रे सँस्रावान् समवनीय यजमान एव प्रत्यक्षं भक्षयति ।
11.13.83.m: There, having poured together the residues of these [cups] belonging to Prajāpati into the principal vessel, the sacrificer alone consumes [them] directly.

11.13.83.s: api vainān sarvaśa eva camaseṣu vyavanīya bhakṣayeyur ity etad aparam
11.13.83.d: अपि वैनान् सर्वश एव चमसेषु व्यवनीय भक्षयेयुर् इत्य् एतद् अपरम्
11.13.83.m: Or else they may consume them having poured them out completely into the goblets—this is the alternative.

11.13.83.s: atra yan mārutyā anavadānīyaṃ tad ṛtvigbhya upaharati
11.13.83.d: अत्र यन् मारुत्या अनवदानीयं तद् ऋत्विग्भ्य उपहरति
11.13.83.m: There, whatever [portion] of the [victim] belonging to the Maruts is not to be cut into cuttings, that he brings to the officiating priests.

11.13.83.s: tad etat samāvaccho vibhajya prāśnanti hotṛcamasam evaite trayaḥ samupahūya bhakṣayanti
11.13.83.d: तद् एतत् समावच्छो विभज्य प्राश्नन्ति होतृचमसम् एवैते त्रयः समुपहूय भक्षयन्ति
11.13.83.m: Having divided it into equal portions, they eat it. Having mutually invited each other, these three consume only the hotṛ priest's goblet.

11.13.83.s: yathācamasaṃ camasān hinva me | ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśante
11.13.83.d: यथाचमसं चमसान् हिन्व मे । इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशन्ते
11.13.83.m: [They consume] the goblets according to their respective goblets. They touch themselves, with: "Invigorate my..."
They do not swell the goblets. Having consumed everything, they cleanse themselves.

11.13.83.s: atha saṃpraiṣam āha | agnīd aupayajān aṅgārān āhara | upayaṣṭar upasīda brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ samidham ādhāyāgnīd agnīn sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi | iti |
11.13.83.d: अथ संप्रैषम् आह । अग्नीद् औपयजान् अङ्गारान् आहर । उपयष्टर् उपसीद ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः समिधम् आधायाग्नीद् अग्नीन् सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि । इति ।
11.13.83.m: Then he utters the direction: "O āgnīdhra priest, bring the coals for the auxiliary offerings! O secondary sacrificer, sit near! O brahman priest, we shall set forth! O āgnīdhra priest, having placed kindling wood, wipe each of the fires once!"
They bring these coals for the auxiliary offerings from the āgnīdhrīya fire.

11.13.84.s: tān agreṇa hotāraṃ nivapati | upasīdaty upayaṣṭā gudatṛtīyair
11.13.84.d: तान् अग्रेण होतारं निवपति । उपसीदत्य् उपयष्टा गुदतृतीयैर्
11.13.84.m: He pours them down in front of the hotṛ priest. The secondary sacrificer sits down with the third portions of the entrails.
There, having divided these third portions of the entrails into eleven parts, the secondary sacrificer performs the auxiliary offerings.
The rest from here on is identical. The Vājapeya is concluded.

11.13.84.s: vājapeyeneṣṭvā pratyavarohaṇīyenāgniṣṭomena yajeta saṃtiṣṭhate vājapeyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate vājapeyaḥ ||
11.13.84.d: वाजपेयेनेष्ट्वा प्रत्यवरोहणीयेनाग्निष्टोमेन यजेत संतिष्ठते वाजपेयः संतिष्ठते वाजपेयः ॥
11.13.84.m: Having sacrificed with the Vājapeya, one should sacrifice with the Pratyavarohaṇīya agniṣṭoma. The Vājapeya is concluded; the Vājapeya is concluded.

12.1.85.s: rājasūyena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa purastāt phālgunyai vā caitryai vā paurṇamāsyā āmāvāsyena haviṣeṣṭvā dīkṣate
12.1.85.d: राजसूयेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स पुरस्तात् फाल्गुन्यै वा चैत्र्यै वा पौर्णमास्या आमावास्येन हविषेष्ट्वा दीक्षते
12.1.85.m: One is going to sacrifice with the Rājasūya: he, before the full moon day of Phālguna or of Caitra, having sacrificed with the new-moon oblation, undergoes consecration.

12.1.85.s: tasya tisro dīkṣās tisra upasadaḥ saptamyāṃ prasutaḥ
12.1.85.d: तस्य तिस्रो दीक्षास् तिस्र उपसदः सप्तम्यां प्रसुतः
12.1.85.m: For him there are three consecration days, three upasad days; on the seventh day the soma is pressed.

12.1.85.s: saṃtiṣṭhata eṣa prāyaṇīyo 'gniṣṭomaś catuṣṭomaḥ sahasradakṣiṇa udavasānīyāntas |
12.1.85.d: संतिष्ठत एष प्रायणीयो ऽग्निष्टोमश् चतुष्टोमः सहस्रदक्षिण उदवसानीयान्तस् ।
12.1.85.m: This preparatory agniṣṭoma concludes, being a catuṣṭoma, having a thousand dakṣiṇās, and ending with the concluding bath.

12.1.85.s: athāṣṭame 'hny ānumataṃ nirvapati haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjate
12.1.85.d: अथाष्टमे ऽह्न्य् आनुमतं निर्वपति हविष्कृता वाचं विसृजते
12.1.85.m: Then on the eighth day he pours out [grain] for Anumati. He releases speech with the call to the preparer of the oblation (haviṣkṛt).

12.1.85.s: samānaṃ karmādhivapanāt | adhyupya dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasyāṣṭau kapālāny upadadhāty ekaṃ pratiprasthātottarato nairṛtāya
12.1.85.d: समानं कर्माधिवपनात् । अध्युप्य दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्याष्टौ कपालान्य् उपदधात्य् एकं प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरतो नैरृताय
12.1.85.m: The rite is identical up to the pouring of the grain upon the mill-stone. Having poured it out, he places eight potsherds in the southern half of the gārhapatya fire; the pratiprasthātṛ priest places one [potsherd] to the north for the offering to Nirṛti.

12.1.85.s: haviḥpeṣyai prayacchann āha prācaś ca pratīcaś ca vyavaśātayantī piṇḍḍhi | iti
12.1.85.d: हविःपेष्यै प्रयच्छन्न् आह प्राचश् च प्रतीचश् च व्यवशातयन्ती पिण्ड्ढि । इति
12.1.85.m: Handing [the grain] to the grinder of the oblation, he says: "Crush it, separating those [grains] that fall eastward and westward!"

12.1.85.s: sa ye prāñcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante tān adhvaryuḥ samupya saṃyutyānumatam̐ śrapayati |
12.1.85.d: स ये प्राञ्चः शम्याया अवशीयन्ते तान् अध्वर्युः समुप्य संयुत्यानुमतँ श्रपयति ।
12.1.85.m: Then, those [grains] which fall to the east of the yoke-pin, the adhvaryu priest, having collected them and mixed them, cooks the [cake] for Anumati.

12.1.85.s: atha ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante tān pratiprasthātā samupya saṃyutya nairṛtam̐ śrapayati |
12.1.85.d: अथ ये प्रत्यञ्चः शम्याया अवशीयन्ते तान् प्रतिप्रस्थाता समुप्य संयुत्य नैरृतँ श्रपयति ।
12.1.85.m: Then, those [grains] which fall to the west of the yoke-pin, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having collected them and mixed them, cooks the [cake] for Nirṛti.

12.1.85.s: ādadata etaṃ nairṛtam upastīrṇābhighāritaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣamantam āgārād ekolmukam udapātram iti |
12.1.85.d: आददत एतं नैरृतम् उपस्तीर्णाभिघारितं कृष्णं वासः कृष्णतूषमन्तम् आगाराद् एकोल्मुकम् उदपात्रम् इति ।
12.1.85.m: They take this [cake] for Nirṛti with under-spreading and dripping [of ghee], a black garment with a black fringe, from the house a single firebrand, and a water-pot.

12.1.85.s: etat samādāya gārhapatye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti vīhi svāhāhutiṃ juṣāṇas | iti |
12.1.85.d: एतत् समादाय गार्हपत्ये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति वीहि स्वाहाहुतिं जुषाणस् । इति ।
12.1.85.m: Having taken this, he offers a ladle libation on the gārhapatya fire, with: "Partake of the oblation, enjoying the svāhā call!"

12.1.85.s: atha dakṣiṇayā dvāropaniṣkramya tāṃ diśaṃ yanti yatrāsya svakṛtamiriṇam̐ spaṣṭaṃ bhavati pradaro vā
12.1.85.d: अथ दक्षिणया द्वारोपनिष्क्रम्य तां दिशं यन्ति यत्रास्य स्वकृतमिरिणँ स्पष्टं भवति प्रदरो वा
12.1.85.m: Then, going out by the southern door, they go in that direction where there is a distinct natural barren soil or a fissure.

12.1.86.s: tad etad ekolmukam upasamādhāya saṃparistīryāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ parigṛhya nairṛtaṃ juhoti | eṣa te nirṛte bhāgo bhūte haviṣmaty asi muñcemam am̐hasaḥ svāhā | iti |
12.1.86.d: तद् एतद् एकोल्मुकम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्याङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां परिगृह्य नैरृतं जुहोति । एष ते निरृते भागो भूते हविष्मत्य् असि मुञ्चेमम् अँहसः स्वाहा । इति ।
12.1.86.m: Having piled up this single firebrand there, strewn grass around it, and taken hold of the [cake] for Nirṛti with both thumbs, he offers it, with: "This is your share, O Nirṛti, in the creature who has the oblation; release this one from distress, svāhā!"

12.1.86.s: atra kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ dadāti | athāpo vyatiṣicya parāsya pātram anavekṣamāṇā āyanti hastapādān prakṣālyaitenaiva yathetam etya gārhapatye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra | iti |
12.1.86.d: अत्र कृष्णं वासः कृष्णतूषं ददाति । अथापो व्यतिषिच्य परास्य पात्रम् अनवेक्षमाणा आयन्ति हस्तपादान् प्रक्षाल्यैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य गार्हपत्ये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकार । इति ।
12.1.86.m: Here he gives a black garment with black fringes. Then, having poured out water and thrown away the vessel, they return without looking back; having washed their hands and feet and gone back by the same way they came, he offers a ladle libation on the gārhapatya fire [with the mantra]: 'Svāhā! Homage to him who has done this!'
Then he concludes [the rite] with [an oblation] to Anumati. He gives a milch cow.

12.2.86.s: atha navame 'hny ādityaṃ caruṃ nirvapati varaṃ dadāti | atha daśame 'hny āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam |
12.2.86.d: अथ नवमे ऽह्न्य् आदित्यं चरुं निर्वपति वरं ददाति । अथ दशमे ऽह्न्य् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम् ।
12.2.86.m: Then on the ninth day he measures out a caru for Aditi. He gives a choice gift. Then on the tenth day [he measures out] a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu.

12.2.86.s: vāmanaṃ vahinaṃ dadāti | athaikādaśe 'hny agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālam |
12.2.86.d: वामनं वहिनं ददाति । अथैकादशे ऽह्न्य् अग्नीषोमीयम् एकादशकपालम् ।
12.2.86.m: He gives a draught dwarf-ox. Then on the eleventh day [he measures out] a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Soma.

12.2.86.s: hiraṇyaṃ dadāti | atha dvādaśe 'hny aindram ekādaśakapālam
12.2.86.d: हिरण्यं ददाति । अथ द्वादशे ऽह्न्य् ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालम्
12.2.86.m: He gives gold. Then on the twelfth day [he measures out] a cake on eleven potsherds for Indra.

12.2.86.s: ṛṣabhaṃ vahinaṃ dadāti atha trayodaśe 'hny āgneyam aṣṭākapālam aindraṃ dadhi |
12.2.86.d: ऋषभं वहिनं ददाति अथ त्रयोदशे ऽह्न्य् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् ऐन्द्रं दधि ।
12.2.86.m: He gives a draught bull. Then on the thirteenth day [he measures out] a cake on eight potsherds for Agni, and curds for Indra.

12.2.86.s: ṛṣabhaṃ vahinaṃ dadāti | athopātītyāgrayaṇahavīm̐ṣi caturdaśe 'hni sarasvatyai caram |
12.2.86.d: ऋषभं वहिनं ददाति । अथोपातीत्याग्रयणहवीँषि चतुर्दशे ऽह्नि सरस्वत्यै चरम् ।
12.2.86.m: He gives a draught bull. Then, having passed by the oblations of the first fruits, on the fourteenth day [he measures out] a caru for Sarasvatī.

12.2.86.s: atha pañcadaśe 'hni sarasvate carum | vatsataraṃ dadāti yady u vai caturdaśyām evopavasathaḥ saṃpadyata evam evaitad ahar etābhyām iṣṭibhyāṃ nānābarhirbhyāṃ yajeta |
12.2.86.d: अथ पञ्चदशे ऽह्नि सरस्वते चरुम् । वत्सतरं ददाति यद्य् उ वै चतुर्दश्याम् एवोपवसथः संपद्यत एवम् एवैतद् अहर् एताभ्याम् इष्टिभ्यां नानाबर्हिर्भ्यां यजेत ।
12.2.86.m: Then on the fifteenth day [he measures out] a caru for Sarasvant. He gives a young bull. And if the fast-day falls on the fourteenth day itself, then indeed on this day he should sacrifice with these two offerings on two separate layers of sacrificial grass.

12.2.86.s: athāsyaitad ahar viśvebhyo devebhyo vatsā apākṛtā bhavanti
12.2.86.d: अथास्यैतद् अहर् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो वत्सा अपाकृता भवन्ति
12.2.86.m: Then on this day the calves are separated for the Viśve Devas.

12.2.86.s: vaiśvadevaṃ payo dohayitvopavasati sāṃnāyyasya vāvṛtā tūṣṇīṃ vā |
12.2.86.d: वैश्वदेवं पयो दोहयित्वोपवसति सांनाय्यस्य वावृता तूष्णीं वा ।
12.2.86.m: Having caused the milk for the Viśve Devas to be milked, he fasts, either according to the procedure of the curd-and-milk oblation or silently.

12.2.87.s: atha śvo bhūte vaiśvadevahavirbhir iṣṭvā paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā prasiddhaṃ nivartayate |
12.2.87.d: अथ श्वो भूते वैश्वदेवहविर्भिर् इष्ट्वा पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा प्रसिद्धं निवर्तयते ।
12.2.87.m: Then on the following day, having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva oblations and having sacrificed with the full moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], he shaves [his hair and beard] in the prescribed manner.

12.2.87.s: atha śvo bhūta indrāya sutrāmṇe puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati |
12.2.87.d: अथ श्वो भूत इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पुरोडाशम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपति ।
12.2.87.m: Then on the following day he measures out a cake on eleven potsherds for Indra Sutrāman.

12.2.87.s: abhihito ratha ubhākām̐syakavaco garbhiṇībhir vā vaḍabābhir yuktaḥ sāṇḍair vāśvair āveṣṭyo niṣkas tad dadāti |
12.2.87.d: अभिहितो रथ उभाकाँस्यकवचो गर्भिणीभिर् वा वडबाभिर् युक्तः साण्डैर् वाश्वैर् आवेष्ट्यो निष्कस् तद् ददाति ।
12.2.87.m: A chariot that is yoked, having bronze-plated armor, harnessed with pregnant mares or with stallions, [and] a necklace to be wrapped around: that he gives.

12.2.87.s: atha śvo bhūta indrāyām̐homuce puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati |
12.2.87.d: अथ श्वो भूत इन्द्रायाँहोमुचे पुरोडाशम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपति ।
12.2.87.m: Then on the following day he measures out a cake on eleven potsherds for Indra Aṃhomuc.

12.2.87.s: anabhihito ratho 'kām̐syakavaco 'garbhābhir vā vaḍabābhir yukto niraṣṭair vāśvaiḥ ślakṣṇako niṣkas tad dadāti ||
12.2.87.d: अनभिहितो रथो ऽकाँस्यकवचो ऽगर्भाभिर् वा वडबाभिर् युक्तो निरष्टैर् वाश्वैः श्लक्ष्णको निष्कस् तद् ददाति ॥
12.2.87.m: A chariot that is not yoked, without bronze-plated armor, harnessed with non-pregnant mares or with castrated horses, [and] a smooth necklace: that he gives.

12.3.87.s: ete saṃtanī ity ācakṣate | atha śvo bhūte saṃtanībhyām eva pratipadyate
12.3.87.d: एते संतनी इत्य् आचक्षते । अथ श्वो भूते संतनीभ्याम् एव प्रतिपद्यते
12.3.87.m: These they call the Saṃtanī offerings. Then on the following day he begins with the Saṃtanī offerings themselves.

12.3.87.s: sa evam eva saṃtanībhyām aharahar viparyāsaṃ yajamānaś caturo māsa eti kāmam iṣṭyā kāmaṃ paśubandhena kāmaṃ yavāgrayaṇena |
12.3.87.d: स एवम् एव संतनीभ्याम् अहरहर् विपर्यासं यजमानश् चतुरो मास एति कामम् इष्ट्या कामं पशुबन्धेन कामं यवाग्रयणेन ।
12.3.87.m: Thus indeed, alternating each day between the two Saṃtanī offerings, the sacrificer proceeds for four months, optionally with an offering, optionally with an animal sacrifice, optionally with the barley first-fruits offering.

12.3.88.s: atha caturṣu māseṣu paryaveteṣu saṃtanyeṣṭyeṣṭvā varuṇapraghātahavirbhir iṣṭvā paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā prasiddhaṃ nivartayate |
12.3.88.d: अथ चतुर्षु मासेषु पर्यवेतेषु संतन्येष्ट्येष्ट्वा वरुणप्रघातहविर्भिर् इष्ट्वा पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा प्रसिद्धं निवर्तयते ।
12.3.88.m: Then, when four months have elapsed, having sacrificed with the Saṃtanī offering, having sacrificed with the Varuṇapraghāsa oblations, [and] having sacrificed with the full moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], he shaves [his hair and beard] in the prescribed manner.

12.3.88.s: atha śvo bhūte saṃtanībhyām eva pratipadyate sa evam eva saṃtanībhyām aharahar viparyāsaṃ yajamāno 'parām̐ś caturo māsa eti kāmam iṣṭvā kāmaṃ paśubandhena kāmam̐ śyāmākāgrayaṇena |
12.3.88.d: अथ श्वो भूते संतनीभ्याम् एव प्रतिपद्यते स एवम् एव संतनीभ्याम् अहरहर् विपर्यासं यजमानो ऽपराँश् चतुरो मास एति कामम् इष्ट्वा कामं पशुबन्धेन कामँ श्यामाकाग्रयणेन ।
12.3.88.m: Then on the following day he begins with the Saṃtanī offerings themselves. Thus indeed, alternating each day between the two Saṃtanī offerings, the sacrificer proceeds for another four months, optionally having sacrificed, optionally with an animal sacrifice, optionally with the wild-rice first-fruits offering.

12.3.88.s: atha caturṣu māseṣu paryaveteṣu saṃtanyeṣṭyeṣṭvā sākamedhahavirbhir iṣṭvā paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā prasiddhaṃ nivartayate |
12.3.88.d: अथ चतुर्षु मासेषु पर्यवेतेषु संतन्येष्ट्येष्ट्वा साकमेधहविर्भिर् इष्ट्वा पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा प्रसिद्धं निवर्तयते ।
12.3.88.m: Then, when four months have elapsed, having sacrificed with the Saṃtanī offering, having sacrificed with the Sākamedha oblations, [and] having sacrificed with the full moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], he shaves [his hair and beard] in the prescribed manner.

12.3.88.s: atha śvo bhūte saṃtanībhyām eva pratipadyate
12.3.88.d: अथ श्वो भूते संतनीभ्याम् एव प्रतिपद्यते
12.3.88.m: Then on the following day he begins with the Saṃtanī offerings themselves.

12.3.88.s: sa evam eva saṃtanībhyām aharahar viparyāsaṃ yajamāno 'parām̐ś caturo māsa eti kāmam iṣṭyā kāmaṃ paśubandhena kāmaṃ vrīhyāgrayaṇena |
12.3.88.d: स एवम् एव संतनीभ्याम् अहरहर् विपर्यासं यजमानो ऽपराँश् चतुरो मास एति कामम् इष्ट्या कामं पशुबन्धेन कामं व्रीह्याग्रयणेन ।
12.3.88.m: Thus indeed, alternating each day between the two Saṃtanī offerings, the sacrificer proceeds for another four months, optionally with an offering, optionally with an animal sacrifice, optionally with the paddy first-fruits offering.

12.3.88.s: atha caturṣu māseṣu paryaveteṣu saṃtanyeṣṭyeṣṭvā śunāsīrīyahavirbhir iṣṭvā paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvā prasiddhaṃ nivartayate |
12.3.88.d: अथ चतुर्षु मासेषु पर्यवेतेषु संतन्येष्ट्येष्ट्वा शुनासीरीयहविर्भिर् इष्ट्वा पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा प्रसिद्धं निवर्तयते ।
12.3.88.m: Then, when four months have elapsed, having sacrificed with the Saṃtanī offering, having sacrificed with the Śunāsīrīya oblations, [and] having sacrificed with the full moon and Vaimṛdha [offerings], he shaves [his hair and beard] in the prescribed manner.

12.3.88.s: atha śvo bhūte saṃtanībhyām eva pratipadyate sa evam eva saṃtanībhyām aharahar viparyāsaṃ yajamānaḥ saptāhānyeti kāmam iṣṭyā kāmaṃ paśubandhena |
12.3.88.d: अथ श्वो भूते संतनीभ्याम् एव प्रतिपद्यते स एवम् एव संतनीभ्याम् अहरहर् विपर्यासं यजमानः सप्ताहान्येति कामम् इष्ट्या कामं पशुबन्धेन ।
12.3.88.m: Then on the following day he begins with the Saṃtanī offerings themselves. Thus indeed, alternating each day between the two Saṃtanī offerings, the sacrificer proceeds for seven days, optionally with an offering, optionally with an animal sacrifice.

12.3.88.s: athāṣṭame 'hnīndraturīyam āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum aindraṃ dadhi vāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ carum
12.3.88.d: अथाष्टमे ऽह्नीन्द्रतुरीयम् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति रौद्रं गावीधुकं चरुम् ऐन्द्रं दधि वारुणं यवमयं चरुम्
12.3.88.m: Then on the eighth day he measures out the Indraturīya [offerings]: a cake on eight potsherds for Agni, a caru of gavidhukā grains for Rudra, curds for Indra, [and] a caru made of barley for Varuṇa.
Having placed the anvāhārya cooked rice, he gives a draught cow.

12.4.88.s: atha tadānīm eva pañcedhmīyena pratipadyate pañcadhāṅgārān nirūhya pañcedhmān abhyādadhāti parṇamayaṃ purastān naiyagrodhaṃ dakṣiṇata āśvatthaṃ paścād audumbaram uttarāt plākṣaṃ madhye |
12.4.88.d: अथ तदानीम् एव पञ्चेध्मीयेन प्रतिपद्यते पञ्चधाङ्गारान् निरूह्य पञ्चेध्मान् अभ्यादधाति पर्णमयं पुरस्तान् नैयग्रोधं दक्षिणत आश्वत्थं पश्चाद् औदुम्बरम् उत्तरात् प्लाक्षं मध्ये ।
12.4.88.m: Then right then he begins with the five-fuel-sticks ritual. Having pushed the embers into five portions, he places the five kindling sticks upon them: one of parṇa wood in the east, one of banyan wood in the south, one of aśvattha wood in the west, one of udumbara wood in the north, [and] one of plakṣa wood in the middle.

12.4.88.s: athainān ājyena vyāghārayati ye devāḥ puraḥsado 'gninetrā rakṣohaṇas te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā dakṣiṇasadas | ye devāḥ paścātsadas | ye devā uttarasadas | ye devā upariṣadas | iti |
12.4.88.d: अथैनान् आज्येन व्याघारयति ये देवाः पुरःसदो ऽग्निनेत्रा रक्षोहणस् ते नः पान्तु ते नो ऽवन्तु तेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यः स्वाहा ये देवा दक्षिणसदस् । ये देवाः पश्चात्सदस् । ये देवा उत्तरसदस् । ये देवा उपरिषदस् । इति ।
12.4.88.m: Then he sprinkles them with clarified butter [with the mantras]: 'Those gods who sit in the east, led by Agni, slayers of rakṣases, may they protect us, may they help us; homage to them, svāhā to them!', 'Those gods who sit in the south...', 'Those gods who sit in the west...', 'Those gods who sit in the north...', 'Those gods who sit above...'.

12.4.89.s: athopaveṣeṇāṅgārān samūhati samūḍham̐ rakṣaḥ saṃdagdham̐ rakṣa idam aham̐ rakṣo 'bhisaṃdahāmi | iti |
12.4.89.d: अथोपवेषेणाङ्गारान् समूहति समूढँ रक्षः संदग्धँ रक्ष इदम् अहँ रक्षो ऽभिसंदहामि । इति ।
12.4.89.m: Then with the poker he pushes the embers together [with the mantra]: 'Gathered together is the rakṣas, burnt up is the rakṣas; here do I burn up the rakṣas!'
