12.16.111.s: saṃtiṣṭhata eṣa ukthyo 'bhiṣecanīyaś catustrim̐śapavamānaḥ sahasradakṣiṇa udavānīyāntaḥ ||
12.16.111.d: संतिष्ठत एष उक्थ्यो ऽभिषेचनीयश् चतुस्त्रिँशपवमानः सहस्रदक्षिण उदवानीयान्तः ॥
12.16.111.m: This anointing rite concludes as an ukthya, having thirty-four pavamāna stomas, with a thousand [cows as] sacrificial fee, ending with the udavasānīyā offering.

12.17.111.s: athāsyaiṣā purastād eva juṣṭe devayajane saptasu śamyāpravyādheṣu śālā kāritā bhavati
12.17.111.d: अथास्यैषा पुरस्ताद् एव जुष्टे देवयजने सप्तसु शम्याप्रव्याधेषु शाला कारिता भवति
12.17.111.m: Now, for him, eastward right on the chosen sacrificial ground, at seven throws of a yoke-pin, a hall has been constructed.
Right there he offers a cake on eight potsherds to Agni.

12.17.112.s: hiraṇyaṃ dadāti śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati sārasvataṃ carum |
12.17.112.d: हिरण्यं ददाति शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति सारस्वतं चरुम् ।
12.17.112.m: He gives gold. Having moved away at a throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there]. [He offers] a mess of boiled rice to Sarasvatī.

12.17.112.s: vatsatarīṃ dadāti dvitīye śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati
12.17.112.d: वत्सतरीं ददाति द्वितीये शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति
12.17.112.m: He gives a heifer. Having moved away at a second throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there].

12.17.112.s: sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālam upadhvastaṃ dadāti tṛtīye śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati
12.17.112.d: सावित्रं द्वादशकपालम् उपध्वस्तं ददाति तृतीये शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति
12.17.112.m: [He offers a cake] on twelve potsherds to Savitar. He gives a speckled beast. Having moved away at a third throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there].
[He offers] a mess of boiled rice to Pūṣan. He gives a dark-coloured beast.

12.17.112.s: caturthe śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati bārhaspatyaṃ carum |
12.17.112.d: चतुर्थे शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति बार्हस्पत्यं चरुम् ।
12.17.112.m: Having moved away at a fourth throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there]. [He offers] a mess of boiled rice to Bṛhaspati.

12.17.112.s: śitipṛṣṭhaṃ dadāti pañcame śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati | aindram ekādaśakapālam
12.17.112.d: शितिपृष्ठं ददाति पञ्चमे शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति । ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालम्
12.17.112.m: He gives a white-backed beast. Having moved away at a fifth throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there]. [He offers a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra.

12.17.112.s: ṛṣabhaṃ dadāti ṣaṣṭhe śamyānyāsa udavasāya vasati
12.17.112.d: ऋषभं ददाति षष्ठे शम्यान्यास उदवसाय वसति
12.17.112.m: He gives a bull. Having moved away at a sixth throw of a yoke-pin, he dwells [there].

12.17.112.s: vāruṇaṃ daśakapālam | mahāniraṣṭaṃ dadāti | atha saptame 'hañ chālām adhyavasyati |
12.17.112.d: वारुणं दशकपालम् । महानिरष्टं ददाति । अथ सप्तमे ऽहञ् छालाम् अध्यवस्यति ।
12.17.112.m: [He offers a cake] on ten potsherds to Varuṇa. He gives a large castrated bull. Then on the seventh day he moves into the hall.

12.17.112.s: etad evāhar dīkṣate | atha vai bhavati sadyo dīkṣayanti sadyaḥ somaṃ krīṇanti puṇḍarisrajāṃ prayacchati | iti |
12.17.112.d: एतद् एवाहर् दीक्षते । अथ वै भवति सद्यो दीक्षयन्ति सद्यः सोमं क्रीणन्ति पुण्डरिस्रजां प्रयच्छति । इति ।
12.17.112.m: On that very day he undergoes initiation. Now indeed it is said: 'They initiate on the same day; on the same day they purchase soma; he gives a garland of lotuses.'

12.17.112.s: athainaṃ tīrthād ānīya pavayitvā puṇḍarisrajinam udānīya dīkṣaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati
12.17.112.d: अथैनं तीर्थाद् आनीय पवयित्वा पुण्डरिस्रजिनम् उदानीय दीक्षणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति
12.17.112.m: Then, having brought him from the bathing place, purified him, and brought him up wearing a lotus garland, he performs the dīkṣaṇīyā offering.

12.17.112.s: tasyām̐ sam̐sthitāyāṃ muṣṭī caiva na karoti vācaṃ ca na yacchati
12.17.112.d: तस्याँ सँस्थितायां मुष्टी चैव न करोति वाचं च न यच्छति
12.17.112.m: When that is completed, he neither makes fists nor restrains his speech.
They place down for him this sacrificial remnant as the fast-food vessel.

12.17.112.s: atha prāyaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjate |
12.17.112.d: अथ प्रायणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति हविष्कृता वाचं विसृजते ।
12.17.112.m: Then he performs the prāyaṇīyā offering. At the call to the oblation-maker, he releases his speech.

12.17.112.s: atrāsmā etad dhavirucchiṣṭaṃ prayacchanti vratabhājanam atha prāyaṇīyena carati
12.17.112.d: अत्रास्मा एतद् धविरुच्छिष्टं प्रयच्छन्ति व्रतभाजनम् अथ प्रायणीयेन चरति
12.17.112.m: Here they give him this sacrificial remnant as the fast-food vessel. Then he proceeds with the prāyaṇīyā offering.

12.17.112.s: prāyaṇīyena caritvā padena carati padena caritvā daśabhiḥ sāṇḍair vatsatarai rājānaṃ krītvohyātithyaṃ nirvapati |
12.17.112.d: प्रायणीयेन चरित्वा पदेन चरति पदेन चरित्वा दशभिः साण्डैर् वत्सतरै राजानं क्रीत्वोह्यातिथ्यं निर्वपति ।
12.17.112.m: Having proceeded with the prāyaṇīyā offering, he proceeds with the footprint [of the cow]. Having proceeded with the footprint, having purchased the King [Soma] with ten one-year-old uncastrated bulls, and having brought him, he performs the ātithyā offering.

12.17.112.s: ātithyena pracarya purastād upasadām̐ saumyaṃ carum | babhruṃ dadāti |
12.17.112.d: आतिथ्येन प्रचर्य पुरस्ताद् उपसदाँ सौम्यं चरुम् । बभ्रुं ददाति ।
12.17.112.m: Having performed the ātithyā offering, before the upasad offerings he [offers] a boiled-rice offering to Soma; he gives a brown [bull].

12.17.112.s: atha madhyame upasadāv antareṇa tvāṣṭram aṣṭākapālam | śuṇṭhaṃ dadāti |
12.17.112.d: अथ मध्यमे उपसदाव् अन्तरेण त्वाष्ट्रम् अष्टाकपालम् । शुण्ठं ददाति ।
12.17.112.m: Then, between the middle upasad offerings, an eight-potsherd cake to Tvaṣṭṛ; he gives a dwarf [bull].

12.17.112.s: athopariṣṭād upasadāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālam | vāmanaṃ dadāti | athāhavanīyaṃ praṇayati |
12.17.112.d: अथोपरिष्टाद् उपसदां वैष्णवं त्रिकपालम् । वामनं ददाति । अथाहवनीयं प्रणयति ।
12.17.112.m: Then, after the upasads, he gives a dwarf [bullock] with a three-pot-sherd [cake] sacred to Viṣṇu. Then he brings forward the āhavanīya fire.

12.17.113.m: Having brought forward the āhavanīya fire, he erects the sadas and the havirdhāna sheds.

12.17.113.s: sadohavirdhāne saṃmityāgnīṣomau praṇayati | agnīṣomau praṇīya yūpasyāvṛtā yūpam ucchrayati
12.17.113.d: सदोहविर्धाने संमित्याग्नीषोमौ प्रणयति । अग्नीषोमौ प्रणीय यूपस्यावृता यूपम् उच्छ्रयति
12.17.113.m: Having erected the sadas and the havirdhāna sheds, he brings forward Agni and Soma. Having brought forward Agni and Soma, he raises the sacrificial post according to the ritual of the sacrificial post.
Having released the sacrificial post that has the svaru-chip, he brings forward the animal sacred to Agni and Soma.

12.17.113.s: tasya prasiddhaṃ vapayā caritvā sārasvatīr vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti |
12.17.113.d: तस्य प्रसिद्धं वपया चरित्वा सारस्वतीर् वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति ।
12.17.113.m: Having performed [the offering] with its omentum in the established manner, he draws the vasatīvarī waters from the Sarasvatī.

12.17.113.s: atha paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirvapati | iḍāntaḥ paśupuroḍāśaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate
12.17.113.d: अथ पशुपुरोडाशं निर्वपति । इडान्तः पशुपुरोडाशः संतिष्ठते
12.17.113.m: Then he apportions the animal-cake. The animal-cake concludes with the iḍā.

12.17.113.s: patnīsaṃyājāntaḥ paśus | hṛdayaśūlānta ity eke | atha vasatīvarīḥ parihṛtya payām̐si viśiṣyopavasanti |
12.17.113.d: पत्नीसंयाजान्तः पशुस् । हृदयशूलान्त इत्य् एके । अथ वसतीवरीः परिहृत्य पयाँसि विशिष्योपवसन्ति ।
12.17.113.m: The animal [sacrifice] concludes with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings, or concludes with the heart-spit according to some. Then, having carried around the vasatīvarī waters and set aside the portions of milk, they keep the fast-day.
Then they awaken indeed in the dead of night.

12.17.113.s: prātarājyāni gṛhītvā rājānam upāvahṛtya prātaranuvākam upākaroti
12.17.113.d: प्रातराज्यानि गृहीत्वा राजानम् उपावहृत्य प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकरोति
12.17.113.m: Having taken the morning clarified butter and brought down King [Soma], he initiates the morning recitation.

12.17.113.d: परिहिते प्रातरनुवाके ऽपो ऽच्छैति । अद्भिर् उदैति ॥
12.17.113.m: When the morning recitation has been concluded, he goes toward the waters. He comes up with the waters.
